title: Loan Servicing Manager - Associate
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

The Loan Servicing & Credit Support Manager – Associate is a pivotal role within our Loans group, essential to the seamless operation of our banking office. This position offers the opportunity to engage with multiple facets of banking operations while executing critical tasks and requirements. Join us to make a significant impact and gain valuable exposure in the financial industry

**Job Summary**

As a Loan Servicing & Credit Support Manager – Associate in our Loans group, you will oversee daily team activities to ensure compliance with Service Level Agreements (SLAs). You will supervise processes such as Deal Closing, Drawdowns, Rollovers, Repayments, Pre-payments, Funding, Rate-Fixings, Fees, and external payments. This role offers a unique opportunity to develop your skills in managing Nostro & Past Due Reconciliation while making a significant impact on our operations.

**Job Responsibilities**

* Monitor the team daily to ensure all SLAs are met and escalate exceptions for resolution.
* Supervise processes including Deal Closing, Drawdowns, Rollovers, Repayments, and Nostro & Past Due Reconciliation.
* Ensure adherence to quality and quantity SLAs with a robust workflow model.
* Serve as the SME, handling complex queries and routing them to onshore teams if needed.
* Implement a Knowledge Management model with SOP maintenance and training.
* Drive 100% compliance with process policies, guidelines, and controls.
* Motivate and support team members to achieve their goals and identify high-potential employees.
* Identify alternatives and options for addressing issues and exploring scenarios.
* Collaborate effectively with colleagues, leveraging diverse skills to achieve goals.
* Identify training needs for process and soft skills to enhance performance.
* Ensure team depth with trained backups for critical work queues.

**Required qualifications, capabilities and skills**

* Hold a bachelor's degree with at least 10 years of relevant experience in loan servicing or credit support within syndicated loans or the financial industry.
* Possess knowledge of loan systems like Loan IQ.
* Demonstrate expertise in nostro/cash matching, General Ledger reconciliation, and SWIFT/remittance systems.
* Exhibit strong problem-solving and investigative skills to analyze and resolve process-related issues.
* Maintain a strong risk and control mindset.
* Understand investment banking products, including loans.
* Drive projects effectively, showcasing strong people, performance, and escalation management skills.

**Preferred qualifications, capabilities and skills**

* Influence and lead conversations effectively with stakeholders.
* Demonstrate executive presence by summarizing, recommending, and presenting issues and solutions to senior management.
* Cultivate strong interpersonal and communication skills for domain learning.
* Apply analytical thinking and problem-solving skills to challenges.
* Understand product lifecycle and area product management.
* Collaborate across teams to drive process improvements and operational excellence.
* Exhibit adaptability and leadership in a dynamic, fast-paced environment

**ABOUT US**  
  
  

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.  
  
We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

  
  
**ABOUT THE TEAM**
  
  
J.P. Morgan's Commercial & Investment Bank is a global leader across banking, markets, securities services and payments. Corporations, governments and institutions throughout the world entrust us with their business in more than 100 countries. The Commercial & Investment Bank provides strategic advice, raises capital, manages risk and extends liquidity in markets around the world.

title: Global Product Specialist Process Performance Motors (flexible location)

Product Line Manager

title: Technical Product Owner
description:
**ROLE SUMMARY:**

As the Technical Product Owner you will need to be technically strong and product-minded as you will be leading the development and evolution of our Content Sourcing Systems!

You will be responsible for defining platform capabilities that enable secure, scalable, and efficient collection of all non-realtime data for LSEG Data and Analytics.

You’ll be joining our Data Platforms Sourcing Engineering team as a Senior Technical Product Owner. This team’s products are the tools used by Content Operations and Data Scientists to find, retrieve, check, validate and transform all the data behind LSEG’s provision of financial market data to over 40,000 customers.

You will work with customers across LSEG to define new tools and capabilities that consolidate, modernise and grow D&A’s data collection.

By building trust with partners, managing expectations transparently, and ensuring alignment across teams, you will build solutions that provide measurable business value. Success will be measured not only by delivery, but also by adoption, customer satisfaction, and time-to-value.

  

**Key responsibilities will include:**

* Defining, prioritizing, and delivering desirable, feasible, viable, and secure Sourcing products.

* Creating the product vision/roadmap, managing the program backlog, identifying customer needs, and aligning ART efforts with business strategy.

* Articulating the roadmap, value decisions and trade-offs, and priorities to customers across the organisation, including senior leaders and non-technical staff.

* Drive PI planning to ensure teams are aligned on outcomes, dependencies and integration

  

**WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING:**

**Platform Ownership:** Own and evolve the product vision, roadmap, and strategy for Sourcing Engineering and its core capabilities, acting as the interface between the business stakeholders and development teams.

**Product Backlog & Outcome:** Own and communicate a product backlog of epics and features, leading trade-off decisions to balance customer needs, architectural integrity, and business value.

**Capability Development:** Define and deliver new platform features to support self-service teams to meet their goals of agility and flexibility in the creation and delivery of data products.

**Strategic Road mapping:** Collaborate with engineering, operations and data strategy leadership to shape the long-term platform strategy based on customer insights, emerging technologies, and enterprise needs.

**Modern Product Practices:** Together with System Architect and Release Train Engineer, lead large-scale agile delivery (SAFe), manage cross-team coordination, and ensure transparency across stakeholders.

**Developer Enablement:** Champion design thinking and user journey clarity to ensure features address real user needs; attend demos and provide approval when deliverables meet business needs.

**Agile Ceremony Cadence:** Drive ART readiness for PI Planning by coordinating across interested parties including, Product Owners, technology, and Business Owners to align scope and objectives.

**Cross ART Collaboration:** Work with other ARTs to set product goals and roadmap; promote shared accountability across functions & streams and proactively calling out blockers & risks to ensure a “no-surprises” environment.

**Innovation, Security & Compliance:** Champion new technologies and processes, balanced against the need to maintain rigorous security controls, and compliance with applicable regulations and laws.

  

**WHAT YOU'LL BRING:**

* 15+ years of professional experience in product management, product ownership, and data or platform engineering or a related field.

* Proven ability to communicate succinctly with functional teams, partners of all levels and leadership.

* Product ownership experience working with Scrum teams, attending scrum ceremonies, owning the scrum team backlog.

* Ability to elicit requirements from customers and articulate them as hierarchical user story format (Epics, Features, Stories).

* Financial services experience; knowledge of data used within financial services.

* Experience of Agile methodologies, ideally with a certification (SAFe or similar).

* Computer Science, Engineering, or a related STEM education.

* Preferred Skills

* Hands-On JIRA and Confluence proficiency, familiarity with agile reporting dashboards.

* Knowledge and experience with end-to-end processes of data collection, processing, and distribution, including understanding of data operations/content operations workflows.

* Exposure to technology platforms, architecture principles, and enterprise integration patterns.

* Experience with value stream mapping, process improvement, and user journey design.

* Strong analytical approach with a focus on measurable outcomes and business value

  

**What you’ll get in return**

**High-impact projects:** We work on a variety of pioneering AI products and leverage extensive datasets to solve complex, high-value challenges.

**Competitive benefits:** You will enjoy a strong compensation package, comprehensive benefits, and ongoing investment in career growth and skill development.

**Industry leadership:** This is an opportunity to be a founding member of the organization that’s delivering brand-new products that democratize modeling and analytics solutions.

**Collaborative environment** : We provide opportunities for continuous learning and professional development in a work environment of dedicated, highly experienced teams.

  

We recognize that to attract the best talent, we need to be flexible, and we are open to discussing work arrangements with you. We take a hybrid approach to the workplace; this role is considered ‘digital first’, which requires attending the office at least one day per week while some teams and colleagues choose to collaborate in the office more frequently.
  
  
You will experience the critical role we have in helping to re-engineer the financial ecosystem to support and drive sustainable economic growth. Together, we are aiming to achieve this growth by accelerating the just transition to net zero, enabling growth of the green economy and creating inclusive economic opportunity.

  

**We're proud to have been recognised as a Great Place to Work® in India ‘25**

  

**Career Stage:**

Manager

**London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG) Information:**

Join us and be part of a team that values innovation, quality, and continuous improvement. If you're ready to take your career to the next level and make a significant impact, we'd love to hear from you.

LSEG is a leading global financial markets infrastructure and data provider. Our purpose is driving financial stability, empowering economies and enabling customers to create sustainable growth.

Our purpose is the foundation on which our culture is built. Our values of **Integrity, Partnership** , **Excellence** and **Change** underpin our purpose and set the standard for everything we do, every day. They go to the heart of who we are and guide our decision making and everyday actions.

Working with us means that you will be part of a dynamic organisation of 25,000 people across 65 countries. However, we will value your individuality and enable you to bring your true self to work so you can help enrich our diverse workforce.

We are proud to be an equal opportunities employer. This means that we do not discriminate on the basis of anyone’s race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. Conforming with applicable law, we can reasonably accommodate applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs.

You will be part of a collaborative and creative culture where we encourage new ideas. We are committed to sustainability across our global business and we are proud to partner with our customers to help them meet their sustainability objectives. Our charity, the LSEG Foundation provides charitable grants to community groups that help people access economic opportunities and build a secure future with financial independence. Colleagues can get involved through fundraising and volunteering.

LSEG offers a range of tailored benefits and support, including healthcare, retirement planning, paid volunteering days and wellbeing initiatives.

title: Assistant Manager Product Control
description:
Some careers shine brighter than others.

If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organizations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realize their ambitions.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of **Assistant Manager Product Control.**

**Purpose of the role:**

This role sits within the Intercompany/Intracompany Derivative Reconciliation Team and focuses on delivering accurate, timely reconciliations and effective issue resolution across intercompany/intracompany derivative portfolios. As an individual contributor, you’ll act as the SME for your assigned processes and portfolios, owning reconciliations end-to-end, applying structured problem-solving to resolve complex breaks, and partnering closely with stakeholders to drive timely closure and strengthen reconciliation controls.

**In this role, you will:**

* To act as an individual contributor delivering daily business controls (Reconciliation and Manual Journals) pertaining to the Global Markets business. Ensure delivery service of Accounting Control - Operations processes as per the standards set out in agreed SLAs within the HSBC Global Resourcing operating framework.
* Assist with production of reconciliations, investigation & root cause analysis of breaks including accounting adjustments to be posted to the books & records.
* Produce accurate and timely management information in conjunction with the In-country/near shore teams ensuring the queries pertaining to deliverables are promptly responded with active business engagement.
* Provide assistance to the Assistant Vice President in day-to-day and periodic reporting requirements and provide leave and off-days cover for other team members. Identify opportunities for improvements. Participate in strategic and tactical change projects undertaken in respective businesses.
* Perform in-depth impact assessment of proposed changes on processes, data and systems and formally document. Plan and schedule project activities aligned with the project plan and ensure timely completion of milestones.
* Manage stakeholder relationships with In-country teams / Near-shore teams, IT teams. Collaborate within the team to and mentor new team members as requested by manager. Provide excellent stakeholder management by ensuring that reconciliations are being provided within the required SLA and break investigation and RCA’s are up to date.

* Process specialist - to support and guide the team and act as a key referral point for escalation for junior team members. Develop realistic and achievable strategies and action plans to address performance gaps, training and staffing requirements.
* Help your immediate manager in implementing and communicating the group targets. Set the right example to junior members of the team. Create an environment within the team which fosters free sharing of knowledge & ideas.
* Prepare and Update Business Contingency Plan (BCP) for Operations Teams. Be aware of issues within teams. All issues / problems are fully analyzed and resolved or escalated in appropriate and timely manner.
* Maintains HSBC internal control standards, including timely implementation of internal and external audit points together with any issues raised by external regulators.

**To be successful you will:**

* Accounting designation is preferred or with 4+ years of total experience in accounting, banking or similar finance roles.
* Graduate degree in Accounting, Finance Management, Commerce or related degree in Finance.
* Relevant experience in a global bank or related operational experience in an organization of similar scale.
* Experience in complex reconciliations across multiple systems and platforms would be preferred
* Preferably experience will cover reconciliation of traded financial instruments and products such as foreign exchange, fixed income, and equities.
* Strong IT skills, particularly MS Excel and MS Access. Strong time management skills
* Excellent communication and presentation skills as the role requires regular interaction with regional teams within the HSBC Group
* Readiness to work in shift hours in different time zones and travel as the business requires.

**You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.**

**www.hsbc.com/careers**

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.”

title: Technical CRM Executive
description:
**We’re Pentland Brands:** a global family business behind some of the world’s most iconic active and lifestyle brands. We bring integrity, energy and ambition to our work, setting high standards and striving to deliver great outcomes without ego.

**Design cycling apparel built for movement, endurance and the ride ahead.**

At Pentland Brands, every role helps move our brands forward. Whether you’re supporting our people, improving our systems, growing our commercial performance, strengthening operations or shaping better ways of working, your impact reaches across a portfolio of iconic brands used by consumers around the world.

This role will be responsible for the hands-on execution and reporting of customer relationship management activities within the ESP, with a primary focus on email and SMS campaign builds, segmentation, and performance tracking. Working closely with the broader CRM team, you will ensure timely and effective deployment of campaigns, leveraging data-driven insights to optimize customer engagement and retention.

As part of a global team managing multiple brands, you will support CRM strategy execution by building, testing, and analysing campaign performance. This role is highly collaborative, requiring interaction with brand, creative, and analytics teams to ensure best-in-class customer experiences.

**What you’ll be doing:**

* Build, test, and deploy email and SMS campaigns within the ESP, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and adherence to best practices.
* Utilize ESP tools to create and manage audience segments, implementing personalization strategies to enhance engagement.
* Maintain campaign workflows, automation, and customer journeys within the ESP, ensuring efficient execution and troubleshooting issues as they arise.
* Track and analyze key email and SMS performance metrics (e.g., open rates, click-through rates, conversions) and generate insights to improve future campaigns.
* Set up and analyze A/B tests to refine subject lines, content, send times, and segmentation strategies.
* Work with brand and creative teams to ensure email templates, dynamic content, and assets align with brand guidelines and best practices.
* Work closely with trade, marketing, and insights teams to align CRM efforts with broader business objectives.
* Assist in data collection and reporting to help inform strategy and decision-making.
* Stay up to date with email and SMS marketing best practices, deliverability standards, and regulatory compliance (e.g., GDPR, CAN-SPAM, etc.).=

**What you’ll bring:**

* **Hands-on ESP Experience:** 2 - 4 years of experience working within an ESP (e.g., Braze, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Iterable) to build and execute campaigns.
* **Campaign Execution Skills:** Experience in email/SMS campaign setup, template editing, scheduling, and automation workflows.
* **Analytical Mindset:** Basic understanding of reporting tools (e.g., Google Analytics, Looker) with the ability to analyse performance metrics and generate insights.
* **Collaboration & Communication:** Strong ability to work with cross-functional teams and communicate findings effectively.
* **Detail-Oriented & Organized:** Ability to manage multiple campaigns and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

**Why Pentland Brands?**

Pentland Brands is the name behind some of the world’s best-known sport, outdoor and lifestyle brands, including Speedo, Berghaus, Canterbury, Endura, Ellesse, Kickers and Mitre.

We are a global family business with a clear purpose: pioneering brands that make life better. Across our teams, functions and locations, we work together to create products, experiences and partnerships that help people live more active, confident and positive lives.

Joining Pentland Brands means becoming part of a business where your work can have real reach, across multiple brands, markets, teams and disciplines. It is a place for people who want to contribute, collaborate, improve how things are done and help build the future of brands with heritage, ambition and global impact.

**Perks & Benefits**

Alongside a competitive salary and discretionary bonus, we offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your wellbeing, flexibility, and life outside work. This includes generous holiday allowance, hybrid and flexible working, employee transportation, pension and gratuity contributions, wellbeing support, medical, personal accident & term life insurance cover.

**The Interview Process**

We want our interview process to feel clear, straightforward, and supportive. If your experience and expectations look like a strong match for the role, here’s what you can expect next:

* **Talent Team Intro Call** - A 30-minute video call with our Talent Team to get to know each other, talk through the role and your experience, and answer any questions you have.
* **Experience Interview** - A more in-depth interview (usually online) with the hiring manager to explore your skills, experience and approach, and how these align with the role, our principles, and our ways of working.
* **Final Interview** - A final in-person interview at our office, focused on deeper discussion and practical application, giving you the chance to meet more of the team and see Pentland Brands in action.

title: Senior Product Manager - Core Data & Decision Intelligence
description:
**Senior Product Manager – Core Data and Decision Intelligence**  
  
**Target in India | L6**  
  
**About Us**  
  
As a Fortune 50 company with more than 400,000 team members worldwide, Target is an iconic brand and one of America’s leading retailers.  
  
Working at Target means the opportunity to help all families discover the joy of everyday life. Caring for our communities is woven into who we are, and we invest in the places we collectively live, work and play. We prioritize relationships, fuel and develop talent by creating growth opportunities, and succeed as one Target team. At our core, our purpose is ingrained in who we are, what we value, and how we work. It’s how we care, grow, and win together.  
  
Target is investing in the next generation of **intelligent store experiences** that connect operational, digital and physical environments to create smarter outcomes for guests, team members and the business.  
  
Our Core Intelligence Product teams are building the foundational capabilities that enable Target’s stores to **understand what is happening, anticipate what matters, recommend the right actions, and continuously learn from outcomes**.  
  
**About the Job – Senior Product Manager, Core Data and Decision Intelligence**  
  
What if a store could understand its operating environment in real time, recognize what matters most and intelligently recommend what should happen next?  
  
That is the future our **Core Data and Intelligence** teams are working toward.  
  
As a Senior Product Manager for Core Intelligence, you will build highly technical products that transform operational and physical signals into trusted intelligence that powers smarter Store decisions and experiences.  
  
You will own a complex intelligence product end-to-end—from deeply understanding the problem and developing product strategy through discovery, experimentation, delivery and measurement of outcomes.  
  
You will work side-by-side with Engineering and Data Science and partner with UX, Store Operations and other Product teams to build scalable capabilities that can power multiple workflows and experiences across Target.  
  
**Product Strategy & Ownership**

* Own the vision, strategy, roadmap and outcomes for a complex Core Intelligence product.
* Develop a deep understanding of Store operations, users and the decisions your product is intended to improve.
* Translate customer and business problems into clear product opportunities and hypotheses.
* Balance immediate use cases with development of reusable capabilities that can scale across Target.
* Define meaningful product health and outcome metrics and use them to drive prioritization and investment decisions.

**Discovery & Intelligence Product Development**

* Lead continuous discovery with Engineering, Data Science, UX, Operations and consuming Product teams.
* Explore how operational context, data science, AI/ML and emerging technologies can solve meaningful Store problems.
* Design experiments and prototypes to test hypotheses before scaling solutions.
* Partner closely with Data Science to define intelligence quality, confidence and feedback mechanisms.
* Build products that continuously learn and improve through real-world outcomes.
* Make thoughtful trade-offs across accuracy, latency, explainability, scalability and business value.

**Product Delivery & Outcomes**

* Own and prioritize the product backlog while maintaining clear connection to strategy and outcomes.
* Partner with Engineering and Data Science throughout discovery, development, launch and learning.
* Make autonomous product decisions within your product area.
* Establish adoption, product-health and outcome measures.
* Continuously evaluate whether the product is solving the intended problem and adjust strategy based on evidence.
* Ensure capabilities are reliable, reusable and extensible where appropriate.

**Cross-Functional Leadership**

* Build trusted partnerships across Engineering, Data Science, UX, Store Operations and Product teams.
* Influence partners and stakeholders through strong product thinking, evidence and storytelling.
* Clearly communicate product strategy, customer problems, trade-offs and outcomes.
* Navigate dependencies across a complex enterprise ecosystem.
* Contribute to the broader Core Intelligence strategy and identify opportunities for reuse across Store experiences.

**About You**

* 4-year college degree or equivalent experience.
* 5+ years of Product Management or relevant product experience.
* Experience owning complex, technical or data-intensive products.
* Strong product discovery and problem-solving capabilities.
* Comfortable partnering deeply with Engineering and Data Science.
* Familiarity with AI/ML, data products, recommendation systems or intelligent platforms is preferred.
* Ability to translate complex technology into intuitive customer and business outcomes.
* Strong analytical thinking and ability to make decisions using imperfect information.
* Excellent communication and cross-functional influence skills.
* Curious, comfortable with ambiguity and energized by building products in emerging problem spaces.

title: Sr. Product Manager, Digital Services AI
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

**What You Will Bring**

title: SAP FICO PM
description:
Role: SAP FICO PM  
Function: Enterprise Technology Solutions – Finance Products, Europe  
Experience: 10–14 years in SAP Finance, including 4\+ years owning solution design and delivery of change through a partner\-led development team  
Reporting to: Finance Products Lead, Europe

Role Purpose

Own the SAP Finance (FICO) product for Europe on the build\-and\-change side. The role is the accountable interface between European Finance business users and the Accenture development pod: converting business demand into the right solution design, getting it built and released on time and to quality, and owning every dependency the partner team will not own — integration, cross\-functional, data, security and infrastructure.

This is a product ownership role, not a coordination role. The person is expected to have an opinion on the design, to say no to the wrong design, and to be credible in front of both a Finance Controller and an Accenture solution architect.

Key Responsibilities

Demand and solution design ownership

* Own the European Finance change pipeline end to end: intake, qualification, business case challenge, solution option analysis, prioritisation with process owners, and release planning.
* Work with business users and process owners to get to the *best* solution rather than the first one proposed — standard SAP over custom, global template over local workaround, reuse over rebuild. Document and defend the rationale.
* Review and sign off functional specifications, solution design documents and architecture decisions produced by the Accenture solution managers before build starts; ensure design fits the global template, the S/4HANA roadmap and the enterprise architecture guardrails.
* Assess and challenge impact on adjacent processes — O2C, P2P, R2R, tax, treasury, costing, intercompany, statutory and group reporting — before committing to a design.
* Maintain the product backlog, roadmap and release calendar for Finance applications in Europe, with clear prioritisation logic visible to stakeholders.

Managing the Accenture delivery team

* Manage the Accenture pod covering solution managers, functional consultants, developers and testers: work allocation, sprint or release commitments, estimate review, dependency clearing and progress tracking.
* Hold the partner accountable for design quality, build quality, unit testing, documentation and on\-time delivery; review estimates critically and challenge padding, scope creep and rebadged effort.
* Run the delivery governance cadence — design authority reviews, daily/weekly stand\-ups, sprint or release reviews, defect triage, go/no\-go decisions — and escalate early when a date is at risk.
* Own the quality gates the partner delivers into: design review, code review/ATC, SIT, UAT entry and exit criteria, cutover readiness and hypercare exit.
* Drive knowledge retention, documentation standards and reduced key\-person dependency across the pod; sign off knowledge transfer before resource rotation.

Cross\-team liaison (dependencies outside the partner scope)

This is a core part of the role, not an occasional extra. The Accenture team will not own these; the Product Manager does.

* Integration / BTP team — specify and drive interface requirements, iFlow design on SAP Integration Suite/CPI, API and event design, error handling and monitoring (AIF), interface testing windows and cutover sequencing.
* Data and MDM teams — master data readiness, data quality rules, migration and conversion objects, ownership of data\-related design decisions.
* Security and GRC — role design, segregation\-of\-duties impact, access approvals and audit/SOX evidence for changes.
* Basis / infrastructure / transport management — landscape availability, transport sequencing across releases, system refresh impact on in\-flight change.
* Other functional product teams and regional/global template owners — cross\-module dependencies, template change requests, alignment where a European requirement touches the global core.
* Third\-party and downstream systems — banking, tax engines, consolidation and reporting platforms, local statutory tools.
* Own the dependency and risk register for the Finance product; chase, unblock and escalate rather than waiting to be told a dependency has slipped.

Stakeholder management and delivery accountability

* Act as the trusted point of contact for European Finance leadership, Controllers, Shared Service Centres and country Finance teams; communicate design trade\-offs, timelines and constraints in business language.
* Manage expectations honestly on scope, cost and date — including saying no, or not yet, with a reasoned alternative.
* Own the plan and the date: baseline it, track it, report status without varnish, and land releases on time with no unmanaged surprises at cutover.
* Protect the financial close calendar — no release, cutover or freeze\-window decision that puts month\-end, quarter\-end or year\-end close at risk.
* Represent the Finance product in change advisory boards, architecture forums and release governance.

Required Skills \& Experience

* 10–14 years in SAP with strong hands\-on functional depth in FICO — GL, AP, AR, Asset Accounting, Banking, Taxation, Product Costing, CO\-PA, Intercompany, period\-end close. S/4HANA experience expected.
* Proven track record of owning solution design and delivering change through a third\-party system integrator (Accenture, TCS, Infosys, Capgemini, IBM or similar) — managing their solution managers and developers, not just receiving their output.
* Demonstrated experience in a large global FMCG/CPG environment of large scale — multi\-country, multi\-company\-code, multi\-currency, global template with local statutory variance, high transaction volumes, complex trade and promotional accounting.
* Strong integration literacy: able to write and challenge an interface requirement, understand SAP BTP / Integration Suite (CPI) patterns, IDocs, APIs and events, and debug integration issues alongside technical teams.
* Cross\-module fluency across FI/CO to MM, SD, PP, and to reporting and consolidation layers; able to spot the downstream impact of a Finance design decision.
* Product management discipline: backlog and roadmap ownership, prioritisation frameworks, requirement writing, release planning, benefits tracking.
* Delivery methods: Agile/Scrum and SAFe alongside stage\-gated project delivery; comfortable with Jira or Azure DevOps and with ServiceNow\-based change governance.
* Change and release governance: ChaRM / Solution Manager / Cloud ALM, transport discipline, CAB, emergency change protocols, audit\-ready traceability.
* Excellent written and spoken English; ability to influence senior Finance stakeholders and hold a partner to account without escalating everything.

Good to Have

* Experience with Central Finance, Group Reporting, Universal Journal, or a Finance transformation/S/4 conversion programme.
* European statutory, VAT/e\-invoicing, and local compliance exposure (e\-invoicing mandates, SAF\-T, Intrastat)

title: Senior Product Manager - Tech, Selection Monitoring
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Amazon’s Selection Monitoring team builds software to improve customer experience by : (1\) Enabling Agentic Shopping experiences through World Product Catalog that contains all shoppable products sold anywhere in the world, (2\) Growing number of customer relevant brands and products on Amazon, and (3\) enriching product and brand information in Amazon catalog. We build state\-of\-the\-art information retrieval infrastructure, extracting structured\-data from unstructured\-content, automatic item classification, storage systems to hold the massive catalog and distributed systems of cloud\-scale. We apply parallel processing, Generative AI solutions, and machine learning algorithms to evaluate millions of products every day and to identify and prioritize new additions to Amazon’s selection efficiently. If you are customer obsessed, driven, tenacious and analytical, you will have fun solving our business problems of unprecedented scale. You will develop deep technical expertise and learn designing large scale distributed, service\-oriented systems. Come join us in our journey to improve our customer experience at Amazon !  

  

Our ideal candidate will have launched multiple, impactful consumer products, have demonstrated the ability to lead high\-performance teams, and have deep understanding of product management, user experience, and software development processes (especially agile). You should be highly analytical, able to work effectively across teams, and thrive in entrepreneurial, fast\-paced work environments.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Lead product strategy and vision supported by internal data and external analysis.
* Define creative, high quality, simple product requirements and roadmaps based on product strategy.
* Manage prioritization and trade\-offs among customer experience, performance and operational support requirements.
* Create buy\-in for the product vision both internally and with key partners
* Work closely with engineering teams to deliver products to market using agile development methodologies.
* Stay current and report on industry trends, including new opportunities, competitor capabilities, etc.
* Measure and analyze existing products and business models for opportunities to innovate and improve, providing additional benefits to developers and customers
* Proactively identify and resolve strategic issues that may impair the team’s ability to meet strategic, financial, and technical goals

  

About the team  

Amazon carries the world’s largest catalog of products and in order to maintain this lead, we are constantly exploring and understanding the global e\-commerce landscape. The mission of Selection Monitoring (SM) team is to collect all publicly available facts and generate insights about brands and products. SM is a global team with the charter to enable World Product Catalog (WPC) and surface these facts and insights to WW Amazon teams where we have an e\-commerce business. SM’s primary objective is to improve Amazon selection and customer experience by discovering, validating, prioritizing off\-Amazon brands and selection.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
* Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
* Experience managing technical products or online services
* Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive\-level prioritization and planning

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience in building and driving adoption of new tools

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Senior Analyst, Strategic Partner Operations
description:
**ABOUT US:**

LSEG (London Stock Exchange Group) is more than a diversified global financial markets infrastructure and data business. We are dedicated, open\-access partners with a dedication to excellence in delivering the services our customers expect from us. With extensive experience, deep knowledge and worldwide presence across financial markets, we enable businesses and economies around the world to fund innovation, manage risk and create jobs. It’s how we’ve contributed to supporting the financial stability and growth of communities and economies globally for more than 300 years. Through a comprehensive suite of trusted financial market infrastructure services – and our open\-access model – we provide the flexibility, stability and trust that enable our customers to pursue their ambitions with confidence and clarity.

  

LSEG is headquartered in the United Kingdom, with significant operations in 65 countries across EMEA, North America, Latin America and Asia Pacific. We employ 25,000 people globally, more than half located in Asia Pacific. LSEG’s ticker symbol is LSEG.

  

**OUR PEOPLE:**

People are at the heart of what we do and drive the success of our business. Our values of Integrity, Partnership, Excellence and Change shape how we think, how we do things and how we help our people fulfil their potential. We embrace diversity and actively seek to attract individuals with unique backgrounds and perspectives. We break down barriers and encourage teamwork, enabling innovation and rapid development of solutions that make a difference. Our workplace generates an enriching and rewarding experience for our people and customers alike. Our vision is to build an inclusive culture in which everyone feels encouraged to fulfil their potential.

  

We know that real personal growth cannot be achieved by simply climbing a career ladder – which is why we encourage and enable a wealth of avenues and interesting opportunities for everyone to broaden and deepen their skills and expertise. As a global organisation spanning 65 countries and one rooted in a culture of growth, opportunity, diversity and innovation, LSEG is a place where everyone can grow, develop and fulfil your potential with meaningful careers.

  

**ROLE PROFILE:**
-----------------


The Strategic Partner Operations team supports the commercial management of LSEG's Strategic Partner ecosystem including Co\-Sell and Re\-Sell Partners. The team is responsible for maintaining accurate partner reporting, supporting revenue share and Co\-Sell reporting processes, and providing a reliable view of the Partner book of business. The team works closely with Partner Directors, Finance and Operations to improve data quality, reporting and operational processes.


The team is also responsible for any improvements in process that minimize manual tasks and improves revenue recognition. The team enables leaders and Partner Directors to make better\-informed decisions by ensuring that Co\-Sell Partner reporting is complete, accurate, timely and translated into actionable insight.


The team is responsible for maintaining and analysing the Partner book of business, consolidating reporting received from partners and internal systems, identifying trends and data\-quality gaps, and improving the processes used to track end\-client relationships, revenue, and partner performance.


The team will also support the development and maintenance of a centralised global repository for Strategic Partner agreements, initially focused on Co\-Sell agreements. This will provide a reliable source of truth for partner contracts, improve accessibility and governance, and support greater consistency in how contractual information is maintained across the organisation.

  

**ROLE SUMMARY:**
-----------------

The successful candidate will support and be a member of the Global Strategic Partners organisation. The key accountability will be to support and maintain reporting across the Co\-Sell Partner portfolio and maintaining a trusted, useful view of the Co\-Sell and Re\-Sell book of business.


The role will involve collecting and validating partner reporting, maintaining accurate partner and end\-client data, reconciling information across internal systems, producing regular reporting and supporting Partner Directors with analysis. The successful candidate will also support the creation and ongoing maintenance of a centralised global repository of Co\-Sell Partner agreements, ensuring contracts and key information are accurately captured, organised and accessible, while supporting improvements to reporting processes and standards as the Co\-Sell and Re\-Sell business grows.

  

  

**WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING:**
-------------------------

* Support the collection, consolidation and analysis of reporting received from Co\-Sell Partners, ensuring submissions are timely, complete and aligned to agreed reporting requirements.


* Maintain the Co\-Sell book of business as a reliable source of truth, including partner, end\-client, revenue, product, geographic information.


* Support the development and maintenance of a centralised global repository for Co\-Sell Partner agreements, consolidating existing contracts and ensuring documentation is complete, accurate and accessible.


* Maintain key contractual information and support ongoing governance of the repository, working with Partner Directors and relevant teams to identify missing agreements or information and keep records current.


* Reconcile partner reported information against internal systems and identify data\-quality issues or discrepancies.


* Produce regular reports and dashboards showing Partner performance, revenue, end\-client activity and key trends.


* Provide analytical and ad\-hoc support to Partner Directors and the Global Strategic Partners leadership team that help prioritise partner opportunities, account activity and commercial focus.


* Identify gaps or potential non\-compliance in reporting, or partner activity and coordinate with relevant participants to investigate and resolve issues.


* Partner with Finance, and other teams to improve the consistency of Co\-Sell revenue attribution

  

**WHAT YOU'LL BRING:**
----------------------

* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and data analysis, with the ability to work confidently with large datasets.


* Experience supporting or analysing a book of business, customer portfolio, partner portfolio or comparable commercial dataset.


* Experience working with CRM, reporting and workflow platforms such as Salesforce, Power BI, or equivalent tools.


* Ability to interpret commercial information and, where required, read agreements or commercial rules to understand reporting obligations and data definitions.


* Good analytical skills and a strong attention to detail, with the ability to identify patterns, anomalies and inconsistencies in complex data.


* Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to turn detailed analysis into concise and actionable messages for senior audiences.


* A strong commitment to data quality, operational rigor and continuous improvement.

  

**WHAT YOU’LL GET IN RETURN:**
------------------------------

As a member of the Global Strategic Partners organisation, you will gain exposure to some of LSEG's most important Co\-Sell and Re\-Sell Partners and to the breadth of Data \& Analytics and Risk Intelligence products and services that underpin those relationships.


You will work closely with Partner Directors and Managers, Sales, Finance, Product, Operations and other specialist teams, giving you a broad understanding of how strategic partnerships are managed and how partner ecosystems contribute to LSEG's growth.


The role offers the opportunity to shape how we measure and manage the Co\-Sell and Re\-Sell business, improve the quality of decision\-making through better data and reporting, and build scalable processes that can support future growth. You will also gain regular exposure to senior leaders and have the support of the wider team to help you develop your commercial, analytical and stakeholder\-management capabilities.


We recognize that to attract the best talent, we need to be flexible, and we are open to discussing work arrangements with you. We take hybrid approach to workplace; and this role is blended .


**Career Stage:**

Senior Associate
**London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG) Information:**

Join us and be part of a team that values innovation, quality, and continuous improvement. If you're ready to take your career to the next level and make a significant impact, we'd love to hear from you.


LSEG is a leading global financial markets infrastructure and data provider. Our purpose is driving financial stability, empowering economies and enabling customers to create sustainable growth.


Our purpose is the foundation on which our culture is built. Our values of **Integrity, Partnership** , **Excellence** and **Change** underpin our purpose and set the standard for everything we do, every day. They go to the heart of who we are and guide our decision making and everyday actions.


Working with us means that you will be part of a dynamic organisation of 25,000 people across 65 countries. However, we will value your individuality and enable you to bring your true self to work so you can help enrich our diverse workforce.


We are proud to be an equal opportunities employer. This means that we do not discriminate on the basis of anyone’s race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. Conforming with applicable law, we can reasonably accommodate applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs.


You will be part of a collaborative and creative culture where we encourage new ideas. We are committed to sustainability across our global business and we are proud to partner with our customers to help them meet their sustainability objectives. Our charity, the LSEG Foundation provides charitable grants to community groups that help people access economic opportunities and build a secure future with financial independence. Colleagues can get involved through fundraising and volunteering.


LSEG offers a range of tailored benefits and support, including healthcare, retirement planning, paid volunteering days and wellbeing initiatives.

title: Sr. Technical Product Manager, Trust CX Innovations
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Trust depends on two things being true at once: that every piece of customer data is governed, controlled, and provably compliant, and that the organization can move fast enough to keep up as products become agentic and ambient. TCI's AI Enablement \& Data Governance charter owns both. On the data side, we make data classification, handling, and retention enforceable and provable rather than asserted. On the enablement side, we build the AI\-driven automation and internal products that take operational load off the whole organization, so builders spend their time creating trust instead of maintaining it by hand.  

  

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager \- Technical to own the product vision and roadmap for this work. You will define the internal products, paved paths, and automation that make data governance provable and that measurably reduce operational burden across every charter. You will translate a broad, ambiguous mandate into a clear product strategy, decide what to build and in what order, and turn it into shipped capabilities that other teams adopt because they are genuinely better and faster. This is a technical product role: you will operate close to data systems, enforcement mechanisms, and AI automation, and you will be expected to reason about the architecture and trade\-offs, not just the surface. You will work across engineering, science, product, privacy, and legal, and you will influence teams beyond your own to adopt the standards you set.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Own the product vision, strategy, and multi\-year roadmap for the charter's data governance and AI enablement products.
* Define the internal products and paved paths that make data classification, handling enforcement, and retention provable, and make adopting them the easy default for other teams.
* Own the product direction for AI\-driven automation that reduces operational burden across charters, and define how its impact on capacity is measured.
* Write the narratives and requirements that align leadership and partner teams, and represent the charter in cross\-organization reviews.
* Partner with engineering and science to make build\-versus\-adopt and automation trade\-offs, and to hold governance and compliance guarantees as product requirements rather than afterthoughts.
* Prioritize ruthlessly across a broad surface, balancing compliance obligations, operational\-efficiency gains, and partner\-team needs.
* Define and track the metrics that prove governance is enforceable and that automation is actually returning capacity, and use them to steer the roadmap.
* Partner with privacy and legal to translate obligations into product requirements that builders can adopt by configuration.
* Influence and align teams beyond your own to build to the standards and paved paths you define.

  

About the team  

Who We Are:  

Trust CX Innovations is a strategic innovation team within Amazon Devices \& Services that focuses on advancing AI technology while prioritizing customer trust and experience. Our team operates at the intersection of artificial intelligence, privacy engineering, and customer\-centric design.  

  

Our Mission:  

To pioneer trustworthy AI innovations that delight customers while setting new standards for privacy and responsible technology development. We aim to transform how Amazon builds AI products by creating solutions that balance innovation with customer trust.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree
* 5\+ years of end to end product delivery experience
* Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
* Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive\-level prioritization and planning
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience in regulatory frameworks and policy analysis methodologies
* Experience delivering large, cross\-functional, customer facing products
* Experience with explainable machine learning and artificial intelligence methodologies and tools
* Experience analyzing data to make business decisions

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related fields
* Advanced knowledge of AI/ML systems, AI model evaluation frameworks, and responsible AI implementation
* Deep understanding of privacy technologies (differential privacy, federated learning, etc.)
* Experience with accessibility technologies and standards (WCAG, Section 508, ADA compliance)
* Knowledge of global privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA, etc.) and accessibility compliance requirements
* Experience with large\-scale distributed systems and their privacy/accessibility implications

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Product Manager I
description:
**Role description**  


At UST, we help the world’s best organizations grow and succeed through transformation. Bringing together the right talent, tools, and ideas, we work with our clients to co\-create lasting change. Together, with over 30,000 employees in 30\+ countries, we build for boundless impact, touching billions of lives in the process. Visit us at **www.ust.com**.


**Summary**

UST is looking for an experienced **Product Owner** to lead product strategy, roadmap planning, and delivery for healthcare and benefits\-focused digital solutions. The ideal candidate will bridge business and technology teams, define product vision, drive value\-based prioritization, and support the adoption of AI\-powered and automation\-driven capabilities.


**The Opportunity**

As a Product Owner, you will be responsible for defining product vision, managing product backlogs, prioritizing features based on business value, and ensuring successful delivery of scalable healthcare solutions. You will work closely with business stakeholders, engineering teams, architects, and leadership to deliver high\-impact products while supporting emerging AI, agentic AI, and automation initiatives.


### **Key Roles \& Responsibilities**


* Define and communicate product vision, roadmap, goals, and business outcomes.
* Gather, analyze, and document business requirements, workflows, and process maps.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to identify priorities, define scope, and align product strategy with organizational objectives.
* Create and manage user stories, epics, measurable acceptance criteria, and product backlogs using Jira.
* Prioritize features and enhancements based on business value, risk, customer impact, and strategic goals.
* Drive Agile delivery processes, including sprint planning, backlog grooming, release planning, and stakeholder reviews.
* Partner with engineering and architecture teams to translate business needs into scalable technical solutions.
* Lead UAT planning, business validation activities, defect triaging, and stakeholder sign\-offs.
* Define AI and automation objectives, success metrics, business KPIs, and human\-review requirements for AI\-enabled solutions.
* Monitor product adoption, user engagement, and business outcomes using analytics and reporting frameworks.
* Develop business cases, ROI assessments, and value realization strategies for product investments.
* Support delivery of healthcare, benefits administration, pharmacy, and digital transformation initiatives.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to ensure alignment across product, business, engineering, and operations.
* Communicate effectively with business and technical audiences, ensuring clarity, brevity, and accuracy in discussions and documentation.

**What You Need**
### **Requirements**


* Strong experience in Product Ownership, Product Management, or Business Analysis roles.
* Expertise in product vision creation, roadmap planning, and business\-value prioritization.
* Experience gathering requirements and managing stakeholder expectations across multiple business units.

title: CRM Lead
description:
**Company Description**  

PhonePe Limited (Formerly PhonePe Private Limited) is a technology company that builds digital platforms for Payments, Digital Distribution Services and Financial Services. Headquartered in India, the PhonePe digital payments app was launched in 2016\. As of April 2026, PhonePe has over 70 Crore life\-till\-date registered users and a digital payments acceptance network spread across over 5 Crore merchants. PhonePe’s products and services include Consumer Payments (including Digital Distribution Services), Merchant Payments, Lending and Insurance Distribution services, and New Platforms, which comprise Share.Market (stock broking and mutual funds distribution platform), and Indus Appstore (Android\-based mobile app marketplace). Culture:  

  

At PhonePe, we go the extra mile to make sure you can bring your best self to work, Everyday!. And that starts with creating the right environment for you. We empower people and trust them to do the right thing. Here, you own your work from start to finish, right from day one. PhonePe\-rs solve complex problems and execute quickly; often building frameworks from scratch. If you’re excited by the idea of building platforms that touch millions, ideating with some of the best minds in the country and executing on your dreams with purpose and speed, join us!

 **Job Description** **About The Role**


We are looking for a CRM Lead who can write high\-converting copy and design automated user journeys across app and web. Your primary focus will be crafting the push notifications, in\-app messages, emails, and WhatsApp sequences that guide users through key financial flows. You bring past experience in fintech or digital banking, knowing how to write clear, simple copy for complex steps like KYC, onboarding, and loan applications. You are a high\-agency strategist who uses writing to improve retention and solve funnel drop\-offs.

**Focus Area 1: Copywriting \& Journey Architecture**

* Core Copywriting: Write all copy for push notifications, in\-app banners, SMS, WhatsApp messages, and email sequences.
* Journey Mapping: Structure communication flows across the user lifecycle, adapting message angles based on user behavior and drop\-off points.
* Funnel Drop\-Off Recovery: Identify friction points in registration and product funnels, writing targeted recovery messaging to bring users back.
* Voice \& Clarity: Keep messaging simple, direct, and transparent across all dynamic templates and automated sequences.

**Focus Area 2: Narrative Experimentation \& Analytics**

* A/B Copy Testing: Run continuous experiments testing subject lines, hooks, message length, call\-to\-action buttons, and value propositions.
* Performance Analysis: Track open rates, click\-through rates, and conversion metrics to see which messaging variations drive actual transactions.
* Dynamic Messaging: Set up modular content rules so message copy automatically adjusts based on user profiles and past activity.

**Focus Area 3: Product Alignment \& Setup**

* Tech Coordination: Work with Product Managers and Tech Leads to trigger the right messages based on specific user events and backend actions.
* Frequency Control: Manage notification schedules to keep messages helpful without annoying users or causing uninstalls.

**What We Are Looking For**

* Fintech / Banking Writing Experience: Direct experience writing product copy and lifecycle campaigns for digital banking, lending, payments, or investment apps.
* CRM Stack Fluency: Hands\-on experience working with tools like MoEngage, CleverTap, WebEngage, or Braze to set up and send written campaigns.
* Analytical Thinking: Ability to read funnel drop\-off charts and figure out what copy change will fix the leak.

**Mindset To Succeed**

* Clear Communication: You know how to distill complex financial products into one or two clear sentences.
* High Agency: You take full ownership of retention metrics, rewriting underperforming campaigns without waiting for a nudge.
* Audience Understanding: You understand user hesitation around financial decisions and write a copy that builds trust and prompts action.

 **Additional Information**  

PhonePe Full Time Employee Benefits (Not applicable for Intern or Contract Roles)  

  

Insurance Benefits \- Medical Insurance, Critical Illness Insurance, Accidental Insurance, Life Insurance Wellness Program \- Employee Assistance Program, Onsite Medical Center, Emergency Support System Parental Support \- Maternity Benefit, Paternity Benefit Program, Adoption Assistance Program, Day\-care Support Program Mobility Benefits \- Relocation benefits, Transfer Support Policy, Travel Policy Retirement Benefits \- Employee PF Contribution, Flexible PF Contribution, Gratuity, NPS, Leave Encashment Other Benefits \- Higher Education Assistance, Car Lease, Salary Advance Policy

The world's brightest technology minds come to Amazon.com to research and develop technology that improves the lives of shoppers and sellers around the world.  

About the Role  

Team Manager, Account Management, North America (NA), Work Timings: 3pm\-12am IST  

As a Manager, Account Management as part of Amazon Vendor Services (AVS) NA Team of Retail Business Services, you will have the exciting opportunity to help shape and deliver on a strategy for managing Amazon AVS North America vendors.  

AVS team is looking for a bright, customer centric, driven, and creative people leader to join our team. The role leads a team of Account Managers responsible for managing business growth for some of the most influential Selling Partners (vendors) on Amazon, ensuring Selling Partner satisfaction with the program through a high level of service and operational standards. In this role, you will manage strategic joint business plans for Selling Partners across your team by collaborating with them to explore innovative ways to identify and execute new selection, merchandising, and operational improvement opportunities. You will interface internally with leaders from our Retail and Vendor Services teams and will be responsible for all aspects of the vendor’s business with Amazon. Your team will engage directly with multiple internal teams to optimize the product line for key manufacturers (vendors) on Amazon. The candidate thrives in an ambiguous environment where they must develop, implement and iterate data, processes, mechanisms and guardrails to improve the customer experience. Further, the candidate is a business owner who understands the key levers to drive business growth and can operationalize those levers across their team. They have a passion for people leadership and are at their best when they’re building, developing and managing high\-performing teams. Your team will utilize a wide range of skills and work across major functional areas such as site merchandising, buying, inventory management, finance, operations and online marketing, to drive the performance of strategic vendor partners at Amazon. In this role you will be focused on the strategic and operational aspects of managing the customer relationships with our vendors.  

You will lead the team to conceive, create and analyze a wide range of marketing and site merchandising efforts, to include marketing campaigns to grow the vendor’s traffic, brand awareness, customer conversion, and revenue on Amazon. Also you will look into strategic and operational aspects of their business with Amazon, root cause analysis of issues and opportunities affecting the vendor’s business.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

Responsibilities Include  

* Lead a team of Account Managers, prioritizing strategic initiatives and provide escalation support as needed.
* Success will be measured by the performance of your internal teams on input metrics and impact of vendors on creating a great customer experience for buying consumers

* Leads recruiting and hiring efforts across direct team and broader organization.
* Manage Selling Partner needs and monitor complexity through efficient resource allocation of Account Managers.
* Monitor Selling Partner satisfaction survey results to analyze both positive and negative feedback trends. Establish improvement plans and mange expectations with Account Managers as appropriate.

* 5\+ years of digital advertising and client facing roles with a focus on data analysis experience
* Bachelor's degree
* Experience analyzing data and best practices to assess performance drivers
* Experience influencing internal and external stakeholders
* Experience with sales CRM tools such as Salesforce or similar software

title: Principal Product Manager, Retail Business Services, RBS: Cost To Serve
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Upstream Defect Elimination (UDE) is a Senior Leadership Team mission to remove unnecessary cost in Amazon's retail business, anchored to a shared S\-Team goal of $5B Cost Out Impact (COI) in 2026, scaling to a proposed $10B in 2027\. UDE requires a myriad of mechanisms and we're in search of a Principal Product Manager to lead the development of the software platform portfolio from within the Retail Business Services team to manage all defects.  

  

Retail Business Services (RBS) is the force multiplier team for Amazon's Retail business growth worldwide through three core strategic initiatives: (1\) Defect Elimination, identifying cross\-all\-retail defects at their root cause and driving extirpation to increase margins; (2\) Selection, creating and enriching Amazon inventory data increasing gross merchandise sales growth; and, (3\) Operational Excellence, to ensure Amazon's retail business is running efficiently and effectively.  

  

RBS evolving a horizontal internal platform complete with a front\-end interface to oversee our UDE program; and, we need an experienced Principal Product Manager to own product vision and lead a small, growing team of product managers as a player\-coach across our tracking, reporting, identification, and extrapolation products. This role has significantly evolved in last couple of years, with additional products and capabilities expected to be either ramped up or developed.
  

  

As the Principal Product Manager, you would own the development life cycle of our UDE platform portfolio spanning defect tracking, reporting. Own the tool which uses AI for defect identification, and extrapolation to enrich defects with root cause, upstream system, and system owner built with an AI\-first development philosophy. Moreover, the leader will lead efforts on simplifying underlying data architectures (with help of dedicated BIE team and central Data Engineering team) for ease of usage of these products, while leading the impact assessment capabilities. It is expected for the leader to continue pushing the envelope on thought leadership via 3YP and Annual plans, which aid not just RBS users, but larger Amazon teams in identifying defects, analyzing and root causing them, assess their impact. The leader is epected to lead a small team to begin with. RBS is investing in this space and depending on forward looking vision, we expect this to become a much larger role with larger team being managed.
  

  

Operating in ambiguity, you would define strategy and invent net\-new mechanisms; the day\-to\-day responsibilities include but are not limited to removing org\-level blockers; ensuring teams are tracking to committed timelines; defining deep product feature requirements; developing a road map; aligning with stakeholders; collaborating with partner teams; and ensuring a successful, on\-time launch.  

  

Work/Life Balance
  

RBS puts a high value on work\-life harmony. We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life\-long happiness and we encourage you to find your own balance between your work and personal lives.  

  

Mentorship \& Career Growth  

Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we're building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. Also, we provide trainings to employees through online learning platforms such as O'Reilly and also encourage them to take up AWS/ML certifications.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

Key Job Responsibilities  

* Experience of managing complex business processes at scale.
* Drive end\-to\-end high impact and high visibility programs that impact WW Retail and hence customer experience on Amazon
* Communication and executive presence with an ability to deal with a fast\-paced environment.
* Experience in defining, developing and using metrics to drive the vision and manage the business.
* Analyze data and dive deep into processes to derive insights for enhancing systems
* Ability to lead not only at the strategic level, but also tactically day\-to\-day by diving deeply into business and technical domains.
* Set AI/ML product strategy, prioritizing capabilities and making build\-vs\-buy calls across the portfolio.
* Liaise with tech, product, ops and category teams to ensure timely deliverables for key projects
* Ability to work effectively \& independently in a fast\-paced environment with tight deadlines.
* Influence VP/SVP/S\-Team decisions and set product direction org\-wide through compelling business documents
* Serve as a role model for Amazon's Leadership Principles and raise the bar for product managers across RBS

  

About the team  

About the Team  

Retail Business Services (RBS) supports Amazon's Retail business growth WW through three core tasks. These are (a) Selection, where RBS sources, creates and enrich ASINs to drive GMS growth; (b) Defect Elimination: where RBS resolves inbound supply chain defects and develops root cause fixes to improve free cash flow and (c) supports operational process for WW Retail teams where there is an air gap in the tech stack.
