title: Software Dev Engineer-II, Infra Supply Chain Automation
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.  

  

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.  

  

These are all greenfield projects offering a rare opportunity to build systems from the ground up. You will be part of a new organization within AWS building large scale distributed applications. We will be designing and developing these systems from scratch utilizing technologies and frameworks like reactive micro services, serverless computing and distributed NoSQL data stores.  

  

If you have a solid understanding of fundamental algorithms and system design and are able to produce bulletproof code, we are looking for you. To succeed in this role, you must be passionate about delivering high\-quality designs and components. You must be creative in solving hard problems and unafraid to think out\-of\-the\-box.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

1\. Solve complex architecture and business problems to come up with extensible solutions.  

2\. Write high quality code that are modular, functional and testable.  

3\. Formally mentor junior engineers on design, coding and troubleshooting.  

4\. Communicate, collaborate and work effectively in a global environment.  

  

About the team  

About the team  

Diverse Experiences  

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  

  

Why AWS  

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  

  

Work/Life Balance  

We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.  

  

Inclusive Team Culture  

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. By leveraging generative Artificial Intelligence (AI), we build intelligent systems that assess, modernize, and deploy enterprise workloads from on\-premises or other clouds directly to modern, cloud\-native architectures.  

  

In this role, you will lead zero\-to\-one AI product initiatives, directly shaping how global enterprises adopt Google Cloud. You will be taking ownership of pioneering technology, high organizational visibility, and the opportunity to work at the intersection of AI and cloud infrastructure.Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. title: Product Manager, Payroll Integrations
description:
**About Rippling**
------------------


Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

  

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

  

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.85B\+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

  

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

 **About the role**


We’re hiring a Product Manager to lead the Payroll Integrations team, which transforms complex payroll activity into accurate accounting data customers can trust. In this role, you’ll define and build the next generation of accounting automations, using AI to build products that generate journal entries, sync payroll data to ERPs, catch errors before they reach the ledger, and help finance teams resolve issues and close their books faster.

  

You’ll own an end\-to\-end product surface with a dedicated engineering team, building for some of Rippling’s largest and most complex payroll customers while partnering closely with customer\-facing teams to translate messy payroll and finance workflows into scalable product experiences.

 **What you will do**

* Set the vision and roadmap for Payroll Integrations, a product area that helps customers turn payroll into accurate financial data they can trust.
* Own the full product experience, from helping customers get set up quickly to making sure data flows reliably into the systems their finance teams depend on.
* Bring AI into real customer workflows so finance teams can catch issues earlier, recover faster, and spend less time on manual follow\-up.
* Partner with engineering, design, and go\-to\-market teams to turn messy operational problems into simple, scalable products.
* Build for some of Rippling’s largest and most complex payroll customers, then generalize those learnings into products that can serve thousands more.
* Make thoughtful prioritization calls across customer commitments, platform reliability, and strategic AI investments

 **What you will need**

* 4\+ years of product management experience, ideally with exposure to payroll, accounting, finance systems, integrations, data platforms, or B2B SaaS workflows.
* Systems thinking: you can understand messy real\-world workflows, model the underlying data and state transitions, and design products that scale beyond the first customer.
* Technical judgment. You should be able to understand how data moves through complex systems, identify where things can break, and partner with engineering to build products that are reliable, scalable, and easy for customers to trust.
* Customer empathy and judgment: you can separate loud symptoms from root causes and build the product customers actually need.
* Ability to operate in ambiguity, make tradeoffs, and drive alignment across engineering, design, support, implementation, and GTM teams.
* Excellent written and verbal communication; you can make complex payroll\-accounting concepts understandable to engineers, customers, executives, and GTM teams.
* Bias for ownership and follow\-through. You don’t just ship features; you own whether the workflow works in production.


If you don’t meet every qualification listed, we still encourage you to apply. Skills and experiences can show up in many forms, and we value diverse perspectives and backgrounds.

description:

Caring for our communities is woven into who we are, and we invest in the places we collectively live, work and play. We prioritize relationships, fuel and develop talent by creating growth opportunities, and succeed as one Target team. At our core, our purpose is ingrained in who we are, what we value, and how we work. It’s how we care, grow, and win together.

  

Fueling the continued success of one of the world’s most beloved and recognized brands is a distinctly capable, creative and innovative Servicing organization well known for inspiring and surprising guests, and we pride ourselves on connecting them to the products and experiences they expect and deserve from Target.

Target Enterprise Services (TES) is a globally integrated organisation focused on delivering operational excellence and enterprise transformation through service operations, procurement, finance, product, analytics, automation, and AI. Operating through a highly collaborative, cross\-functional model, TES partners across the enterprise to simplify processes, improve experiences, reduce friction, create scalable capabilities and unlock business value for Guests, team members, vendors, and business partners.

  

Product Teams at TES are accountable for the delivery of business outcomes enabled through technology, data science and analytic products that are easy to use, easily maintained and highly reliable. Product teams have one shared backlog that is inclusive of all products, technology and design work.


As a Principal Product Manager, you will shape the strategic vision and own the roadmap for a complex product domain. You will partner with Product, Technology, Data, Design, and Operations teams to establish short\- and long\-term goals, define quarterly Objectives and Key Results, prioritise investments, and deliver measurable business outcomes.


The Principal Product Manager based in India is a strategic senior individual contributor who serves as a force multiplier across product strategy, platform evolution, and AI transformation within Target’s Service Centre product ecosystem. This role provides strategic product leadership across business and cross\-functional teams to deliver scalable solutions. The Principal Product Manager will shape the long\-term evolution of Digital Servicing, AI\-enabled experiences, operational platforms, and enterprise insight capabilities serving Guests, team members, partners, and business functions. The role partners closely with the Director of Product Management to transform core servicing capabilities and accelerate the responsible adoption of AI, automation, and intelligent experiences.

Success in this role is demonstrated through the ability to shape the long\-term evolution of Digital Servicing, elevate product management maturity, influence enterprise priorities without direct authority, and deliver measurable improvements in Guest experience, operational efficiency, and business outcomes. The Principal Product Manager is a strategic thought leader, trusted partner, mentor, and force multiplier who accelerates product excellence across the TES portfolio.

* Establish a clear multi\-year vision and roadmap for Digital Servicing, AI\-powered experiences, and servicing platforms.
* Influence product investment decisions to align with TES and enterprise priorities.
* Translate complex business challenges into scalable product opportunities with measurable outcomes.

**Business and Product Outcomes**

* Improve servicing outcomes across Guest experience, team member productivity, operational efficiency, adoption, automation, and cost to serve.
* Deliver measurable progress against product OKRs and enterprise priorities.
* Ensure product investments generate measurable business value rather than technology outputs alone.

* Coach and mentor product practitioners, strengthening customer\-centric problem\-solving and outcome\-based decision\-making.
* Establish consistent product discipline and effective product\-management practices across TES teams.

**Enterprise Influence**

* Serve as a trusted adviser to Product, Technology, Data, Design, Operations, and business leaders.
* Strengthen alignment between business strategy and product execution.
* Reduce decision\-making friction and accelerate execution across organisational and functional boundaries

**About you:**

* Four\-year degree or equivalent experience.
* 10\+ years of product management or equivalent domain experience, preferably within retail, consumer servicing, enterprise platforms, or AI\-enabled products.
* Demonstrated experience defining strategy and roadmaps for complex, enterprise\-scale products or platforms.
* Deep expertise in product discovery, experimentation, prioritisation, outcome\-based roadmaps, and product measurement.
* Experience leading product\-driven transformation across Technology, Data, Design, Operations, and business teams.
* Strong understanding of digital servicing, automation, AI\-enabled experiences, data flows, and platform capabilities.
* Proven ability to influence senior leaders and align stakeholders without direct authority.
* Demonstrated ability to coach and mentor product practitioners and elevate product\-management maturity.
* Strong strategic thinking, communication, storytelling, and data\-driven decision\-making skills.
* Expertise in agile product\-development practices.

With an inclusive culture that embraces a flexible work environment, we foster a spirit of collaboration fueled by boldness, curiosity and commitment that empowers us all to win together.

title: Software Development Engineer, AI Trust & Innovation
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


About the Team  

Amazon's Devices \& Services Trust CX Innovations team is building the future of responsible AI for consumer devices. We deliver privacy\-first, accessible, and trustworthy AI experiences that millions of customers use daily across Amazon's device ecosystem—including Alexa, Echo, and other ambient computing products. Our mission is to ensure that as we push the boundaries of generative AI innovation, we maintain Amazon's high bar for customer trust, privacy, inclusion, and accessibility.  

  

Role Overview  

We are seeking an exceptional Software Development Engineer II to build the foundational systems and consumer\-facing features that enable trustworthy AI experiences at scale. You will partner closely with our Principal Engineers and Managers to design and implement privacy\-preserving AI architectures, responsible AI frameworks, and accessibility features that set the standard for consumer AI products.  

  

This is a high\-impact role where you'll tackle complex technical challenges at the intersection of AI innovation and customer trust—balancing performance with privacy, building explainable AI systems, and creating guardrails that protect customers while enabling delightful experiences.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

What You'll Build  

  

Privacy\-Preserving AI Systems:  

* Design and implement federated learning and differential privacy techniques for on\-device and hybrid AI architectures
* Build privacy\-preserving data pipelines that minimize data collection while maintaining model quality
* Create consent management frameworks and data minimization systems that give customers control
* Architect on\-device vs. cloud processing trade\-offs that optimize for both privacy and performance

  

Consumer\-Facing Trust Features:  

* Develop explainable AI interfaces that help customers understand how AI makes decisions
* Build transparency controls that show customers what data is used and how
* Create privacy dashboards and settings that give customers meaningful control over their AI experiences
* Implement cross\-device identity management with privacy\-first design principles

  

Key Technical Challenges  

* Latency vs. Privacy Trade\-offs: Optimize time\-to\-first\-token and response times while maintaining strong privacy guarantees through on\-device processing and selective cloud offloading


\* AI Safety at Scale: Reduce hallucinations to \* Ambient Computing Privacy: Build privacy controls for always\-on environments that balance proactive assistance with clear boundaries  

* Multimodal AI Systems: Architect distributed systems that handle text, voice, and visual inputs while preserving privacy across modalities
* Real\-time Evaluation: Create low\-latency evaluation systems that assess model outputs for safety, accuracy, and bias before reaching customers

  

What Makes You Successful  

Customer Obsession for Trust: You deeply understand that trust is earned through consistent, transparent, and privacy\-respecting experiences. You make technical decisions that prioritize customer trust even when it means additional complexity.  

  

Technical Excellence: You have strong computer science fundamentals and practical experience building distributed systems. You write clean, maintainable code and establish best practices that enable your team to move fast without breaking things.  

  

AI \& Privacy Expertise: You understand both the capabilities and limitations of modern AI systems. You know how to implement privacy\-preserving techniques without sacrificing user experience.  

  

Bias for Action: You thrive in ambiguous environments where you need to make pragmatic trade\-offs between innovation and safety. You ship iteratively and learn from customer feedback.  

  

Inclusive Mindset: You design systems that work for all customers, considering diverse abilities, contexts, and use cases from the start rather than as an afterthought.  

  

Why Join Us  

* Work on generative AI technology that impacts millions of customers daily
* Shape the future of responsible AI and set industry standards for privacy and trust
* Partner with world\-class product, design, and research teams
* Solve novel technical challenges at the intersection of AI innovation and customer protection
* Build systems that make AI accessible and trustworthy for everyone

  

About the team  

Amazon's Devices \& Services Trust CX Innovations team is building the future of responsible AI for consumer devices. We deliver privacy\-first, accessible, and trustworthy AI experiences that millions of customers use daily across Amazon's device ecosystem—including Alexa, Echo, and other ambient computing products. Our mission is to ensure that as we push the boundaries of generative AI innovation, we maintain Amazon's high bar for customer trust, privacy, inclusion, and accessibility.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 2\+ years of non\-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 3\+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience

title: Sr Product Manager - Media Measurements
description:
**About the role**
==================


We are hiring a Sr. Data Product Manager to own a portfolio of Target Media data products end\-to\-end — from business definitions and contracts through datasets, pipelines, quality, governance, and delivery.


This is a hands\-on role that works closely with Data Engineering, Analytics and Media Partners. You will partner with DE day\-to\-day to build and evolve datasets and pipelines across a medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold) architecture, shape schemas and contracts, and make sure the data products that result are trusted and well\-governed. The core job is to translate technical capability into business outcomes. You will sit at the intersection of Roundel product, Data Engineering, MediaOps, and the broader Media Data Consumers.

**What you’ll own**
===================


We are looking for a Sr. Product Manager — Measurement \& Analytics to lead the strategy, development, and evolution of data products that enable marketing measurement and attribution across Target Media.

**Measurement – Must Have**


This role sits at the intersection of Product, Marketing Measurement, Analytics and Data Engineering. You will own products that help the organization understand the impact of marketing investments across channels, campaigns, audiences, and customer journeys.


The initial focus will be on Roundel and Target marketing spend, with the opportunity to expand measurement capabilities across loyalty, promotions, and other enterprise marketing investments.


A core responsibility will be building and scaling attribution and measurement capabilities that connect marketing exposure and spend to business outcomes, enabling stakeholders to understand what worked, why it worked, and where to invest next.

**Analytics \& Data Fluency — Must Have**
-----------------------------------------


Strong working knowledge of analytics and data concepts, with the ability to partner effectively with Analytics teams. You should be comfortable with:

* Customer\-level and aggregated analytics
* Data aggregation and dimensional modelling
* Data pipelines and data transformations
* Data quality and reconciliation
* Metric definitions and semantic layers

**Building data products with Data Engineering**
------------------------------------------------


You work hand\-in\-hand with Data Engineering to turn requirements into real datasets and pipelines — translating business needs into clear specs, prioritizing the backlog, and making trade\-off calls with DE on design and sequencing.

**Platform \& ecosystem stewardship**
-------------------------------------

**Solid understand of Data Platform, cloud environment of GCP/BQ/PowerBI**
--------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Trust, governance \& data quality — critical**
------------------------------------------------


Data governance and data quality are central to this role, not an afterthought. As operational systems and automated workflows act on Roundel data, the cost of a stale or wrong data product rises sharply.

**What you’ll bring**
=====================

* 10\+ years in product management, with meaningful time across Measurement, data products, data platforms, AdTech/MarTech, or retail media.
* Proven understanding Marketing Measurement concepts of Attribution, MTA, MMM, etc.
* Hands\-on experience working closely with Data Engineering to build datasets and pipelines — writing specs, shaping schemas and contracts, and prioritizing a technical backlog.
* Solid understanding of medallion architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold) and modern data platforms (Lakehouse, data mesh, or federated architectures), including lineage and cost.
* Strong grasp of data governance and data quality — certification, monitoring, access, and consent — treated as critical, not optional.
* Track record of translating technical capability into measurable business outcomes and influencing cross\-functional partners without direct authority.
* Strong understand if PM Practices and working with Data Engineering, Analysts and Stakeholders.

You will work in close collaboration with various teams within Global Technology (e.g., Architecture, Engineering, Product Management, Program Management) and key Functional Teams across the business (e.g., Finance, Tax, Procurement, Order To Cash, Treasury, Royalties, General Accounting etc). The role will require experience designing creative, quality technical products and enabling business capabilities and objectives through technology.

  

  

**WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR**


We are looking for a Lead Product Manager who is a strategic thinker, execution\-driven leader, and passionate advocate for building enterprise\-grade platforms that scale. You are equally comfortable defining long\-term product vision as you are rolling up your sleeves to unblock a squad on delivery. You thrive at the intersection of business, technology, and user needs — and you know how to translate ambiguity into clear, actionable roadmaps.

  

**Skillset Required**


We're looking for someone with at least 6\+ years of experience in product management and clearly demonstrated these skills:


* Bachelor's Degree or a combination of relevant education, experience, and training.
* Experience of working on technology solutions supporting procurement processes (Purchase Orders, Goods Receipts, Invoice receipts, Three\-way Match, Payments, and Remittance).
* Nice to have experience of working on one or more solutions such as SAP Finance and Procurement solutions, Procurement Solutions (COUPA, Fieldglass), and Integration Technologies (AWS Microservices, FUSION, NiFi).
* Strong product management expertise.
* Lead the execution of an end\-to\-end product/platform vision and multi\-year roadmap in partnership with Engineering teams and the Finance business.
* Partner with all stakeholders to understand Business needs, outcomes and value and ensure roadmaps are aligned to those needs.
* Ensure roadmaps account for and integrate dependencies across functional areas within Domains along with technical enablement work as part of platform strategy.
* Collaborating with other Product managers and leaders to address dependencies across teams
* Experience of working in Agile Team following Scrum and experience of working on JIRA and managing day to day product manager activities (Daily Scrum, Backlog Refinement, Planning, and Review), communications and contributing to senior management reports and business presentations.
* Experience working with cross\-functional teams in a dynamic environment for global and country\-specific solutions.
* Strong Analytical, problem solving, and Data Visualization Skills.
* Preferred to have Finance business function knowledge
* Excellent communication skills.
* Validated ability to adapt to new technologies and tools, changing needs, processes, and ambiguity.
* Preferred to have AI/ML experience
  

**What YOU’LL WORK ON**


* Define and own the multi\-year product vision and roadmap for cloud\-based integration capabilities supporting Finance domain
* Drive the end\-to\-end product lifecycle — from discovery and requirements definition, through design, delivery, launch, adoption, and continuous improvement — in close partnership with Architecture, Engineering, and Program Management
* Shape the integration platform strategy leveraging technologies such as AWS microservices, and Apache NiFi, ensuring the platform is scalable, resilient, observable, and cost\-efficient
* Partner with business stakeholders across Finance, Tax, Procurement, Order\-to\-Cash, Treasury, Royalties, and General Accounting to understand pain points, capture business capabilities, and translate them into prioritized product outcomes.
* Manage the product backlog and delivery cadence in an Agile/Scrum environment — leading Daily Scrums, Backlog Refinement, Sprint Planning, Reviews, and Retrospectives — using JIRA to drive transparency and velocity.
* Orchestrate cross\-domain dependencies by collaborating with other Product Managers and Domain Leads to sequence roadmaps, unblock integration points, and ensure end\-to\-end business processes deliver seamlessly.
* Balance run\-the\-business with change\-the\-business work, ensuring the roadmap accounts for both new capability delivery and foundational platform investments
* Define and track success metrics — including adoption, throughput, transaction accuracy, cycle time, cost\-to\-serve, and platform SLAs — and use data to inform prioritization and continuous iteration.
* Communicate effectively across all levels, delivering clear updates to squads
* Champion product management best practices — PRDs, roadmaps, OKRs, discovery techniques, and stakeholder engagement models — and mentor peers to elevate the craft across the team.
* Stay ahead of industry trends in cloud integration, ERP modernization, iPaaS, event\-driven architectures, and finance, procurement transformation, bringing outside\-in perspective to shape the future of the platform.

title: Senior Technical Product Manager
description:
**About Exotel**
================

  



Exotel is the operating system for business communications in emerging markets.



Every day, our platform powers the calls, messages and Voice AI interactions that connect a Bajaj agent to a customer, a Zomato delivery partner to a household, a HDFC banker to a borrower, and a Bolna voicebot to millions of end users.



We process billions of minutes and messages annually across India, Southeast Asia, the Middle East and Africa. We are the substrate underneath one of the fastest\-scaling contact centre and Voice AI ecosystems in the world.

**Own the largest surface we run**
==================================

  



Voice powers thousands of enterprise deployments including HDFC, RBL and international BFSI accounts, and sits underneath the fastest\-growing segment of our business: Voice AI.



It is also the most complex product surface we operate — ExoML APIs, the voice platform, throttling and traffic management, LeadAssist, recording infrastructure, K8S\-based enterprise deployments and real\-time telephony reliability across geographies.



This role is the product owner for that surface.



You define what gets built, why it matters and how success is measured, in close partnership with our Engineering leadership and the go\-to\-market team.



If you want an environment where technical depth is respected, product craft is expected, and the roadmap has real revenue and enterprise weight behind it, this is that seat.

  


**What You Will Own**
=====================

  

* Platform strategy and roadmap \- outcomes, sequencing, and trade\-offs across a 12–18 month horizon. Build ground\-up product stories from customer signals, QBR data, competitive analysis and platform reality. You are not processing inbound requests.
* Platform APIs and payload surface — including AMD, recording status callbacks, disconnectedBy, throttling APIs, and the next generation of programmable platform primitives.
* Enterprise platform deployments
* Cross\-product platform integrations \- with platformbot, CQA, contact centre, and streaming.
* The developer and enterprise customer experience \- including QBR ownership on top 20 accounts and Developer NPS \>45 across the API surface.
* Build ground\-up product stories from customer signals, QBR data, competitive analysis, and platform reality — not just processing inbound requests.

  

**What We’re Looking For**
==========================

  



We care more about what you have actually owned than your previous title.



You have ideally:


* Built real systems as an engineer, and now want to own the product decisions behind them.
* Spent at least 3\-4 years operating in technically complex domains — CPaaS, telephony, developer platforms, API\-first products, data infrastructure or equivalent.
* Read system design docs, held your own in a review with a staff engineer, and known when an engineering estimate is soft.
* Written PRDs engineers actually reference.
* Done real discovery and built user stories from first principles.
* Defended prioritisation with data.
* Taken vague mandates and converted them into executable roadmaps without heavy hand\-holding.
* Committed publicly and held yourself accountable, including to slips.
* Known when to move fast and when to wait, when to be direct and when to be diplomatic, when to hold a scope and when to renegotiate.

  




**This Role May Be a Strong Fit If You Are**
--------------------------------------------



A senior or staff engineer considering a product move. If your technical depth is real and your appetite for product craft is genuine, apply and tell us how you are thinking about the transition. We have seen this path produce some of the best technical PMs in our space.

  



A product manager from a CPaaS\-adjacent developer platform — auth, messaging, payments, analytics infrastructure. The domain\-specific telephony knowledge can be built. The platform thinking and API\-product craft cannot.

**This is probably not the right role if:**
-------------------------------------------

  


* Your experience is primarily roadmap execution and processing inbound requests.
* You have not worked in a technically complex domain and do not want to start.
* You need a well\-defined mandate and close supervision to make progress.

title: Growth Manager- D2C (E-commerce)
description:
**Category / Growth Manager — D2C**


*One growth loop: bring demand in shape the assortment price \& promote time it to the devotional calendar. You own all four.*


**Experience:** 4–5 years


**About AppsForBharat**


AppsForBharat, a series C\-funded faith\-tech startup, is backed by India’s best venture capital investors including Fundamentum, Susquehanna Asia VC, Peak XV partners (prev. Sequoia Capital), Elevation Capital, \& BEENEXT. Our highly ambitious and audacious team comprises alumni from prestigious institutions like IITs \& IIMs, with extensive experience in scaling high\-growth startups. We're dedicated to developing mobile and web apps catering to the devotional and spiritual needs of 100s of millions of users across the globe.


Our flagship product, **Sri Mandir**, launched in November 2020, is the world’s largest app for Hindu devotees. It serves as a digital sanctuary for millions of devotees worldwide. Our mission is to enrich individuals' spiritual lives through innovative technology, offering seamless access to sacred pilgrims \& rituals, divine teachings, and a vibrant community. The overwhelming user love motivates us as we aim to serve 100s of millions more in the coming years.


The devotion market is a $44B opportunity in India (growing at 10% CAGR), which is primarily offline and unorganised. Of the $44B, the temples drive GMV of \~$27B in temple offerings, services, and commerce. There are 2M\+ temples in India \- about 10k of these temples have a strong historical and cultural significance. Tourism to these religious places is a $10B opportunity. The Sri Mandir app is the world’s largest app for Hindu devotees and growing 20\-25% month\-on\-month.

  


Try the Sri Mandir app: **Android** / **iOS**
  

  

**Role Overview**


You own **growth and category** for Srimandir's own D2C channel end\-to\-end.
  

It's a full\-loop role: you **generate the demand**, decide the **assortment** (how deep within a category, how wide across categories), set the **price and promotion**, and orchestrate all of it against India's **devotional calendar**, the rhythm that drives this business. You run the store like a P\&L and grow it.


**What you'll own**


**1 · Category — vertical \& horizontal thinking.** Build the assortment on two axes:


* **Vertical (go deep):** depth and premium ladders within winning categories, drive the NPD pipeline (new SKUs, variants, price tiers).
* **Horizontal (go wide):** expand into new categories, cross\-sell and basket expansion — decide what to add, what to scale, and what to cut.

**2 · Pricing \& promotion.** Set the pricing and margin architecture per category; design the discounting, offers and bundling that grow volume without eroding margin.


**3 · Calendar planning.** Build and run the festive / muhurat / seasonal calendar (Sawan, Navratri, Diwali and the rest) as the operating rhythm \- plan launches, campaigns, inventory and promotions against each peak, well ahead of time.


**4 · Demand generation (Marketing).** Own the funnel end\-to\-end \- traffic (performance marketing across Meta / Google), on\-site / in\-app conversion, and repeat (CRM, notifications, WhatsApp). Partner with performance and creative teams; own the growth number, CAC and ROAS.

  

  

**What success looks like (first 6–12 months)**


* D2C revenue and growth at or above plan; category contribution up.
* AOV and repeat\-purchase rate rising, with healthy CAC / ROAS.
* Margin held while scaling volume, pricing and promo discipline.
* Calendar\-led launches shipped on time, with demand captured at each festival peak.

**What you bring**


* 4–6 years in category management, growth, or D2C e\-commerce \- **deally a mix of category ownership and demand generation.**
* Performance\-marketing fluency \- run or closely partnered on Meta / Google plus CRM / retention.
* Pricing and P\&L comfort; a sharp assortment / NPD instinct (vertical depth \+ horizontal expansion).
* Data\-driven \- strong analytics; makes decisions from funnel and category data.

**Nice to have**


* D2C consumer\-brand / FMCG / e\-commerce background; app or store growth experience.
* Feel for festive, seasonal, calendar\-driven categories.
* Affinity for the spiritual / devotional space and Indian consumer nuance (Hinglish a plus).

title: Software Eng - Content Management Systems
description:
Marcom is the creatively\-led global team that oversees Apple’s consumer facing marketing. We ensure the flawless development and execution of world\-class communications across all medias and platforms. Every day, hundreds of millions of Apple customers around the world interact with our products. We drive the strategy and creative work that provide both new and existing customers with simple, engaging and inspiring marketing experiences.  

Marcom's Interactive Engineering team works on many high\-impact projects that serve various Apple lines of business. We use the latest in open source technologies and continue to evolve and deliver solutions on a worldwide scale. Working with a variety of multi\-functional teams, the Interactive Engineering group brings it all together to deliver the interactive experiences with an excellent group of software engineers while having fun along the way. This team is exciting and fast\-paced; it’s a great place for people with exacting standards who want their work to matter.  

We are looking for a Software Engineer with 3\+ years of experience to design, develop, and enhance modern, distributed, scalable, and high\-performance Content Management Systems (CMS) using Java, open\-source technologies, and modern software engineering practices. This role is critical to the evolution of Apple’s brand as you will be working with the teams taking apple.com to the next phase of its evolution. We are looking for engineers who are passionate about building modern CMS platforms, solving complex content management problems at scale, and leveraging AI\-assisted engineering and agentic workflows to improve both CMS capabilities and software development productivity.  

  

**Description**  

This role provides an opportunity to build modern, distributed, and large\-scale Content Management Systems that power apple.com and enable content to be created, managed, governed, and delivered across multiple digital experiences.  

You will work across Java backend services, CMS platforms, content architecture, content modeling, workflows, APIs, integrations, search, distributed systems, cloud technologies, and AI\-powered engineering workflows.  

The role is suited for an engineer who enjoys solving complex CMS problems at scale and is excited about the evolution of CMS platforms through headless architectures, open\-source technologies, automation, and AI agents.  

The primary focus of this role is CMS engineering.","responsibilities":"Design, develop, customize, and extend the distributed, large\-scale CMS platforms that power apple.com and other Apple digital experiences, supporting high volumes of content.  

Build and enhance capabilities across the content lifecycle, including content creation, modeling, relationships, metadata, taxonomy, workflows, approvals, versioning, localization, publishing, and delivery.  

Work hands\-on with Java\-based open\-source CMS platforms and frameworks and extend their capabilities to meet evolving product and business requirements.  

Design and develop headless and API\-first CMS solutions enabling content delivery across web, mobile, and other digital channels.  

Develop and integrate REST and GraphQL APIs for content authoring, management, preview, search, and delivery using Java and Spring Boot.  

Build integrations between CMS platforms and search, digital asset management, identity, analytics, CDN, and other enterprise systems.  

Design solutions for scalability, high availability, resiliency, fault tolerance, and efficient content delivery in distributed environments.  

Implement caching, indexing, asynchronous processing, and event\-driven mechanisms for large\-scale CMS workloads.  

Work with databases and data models supporting large content repositories and efficient content retrieval.  

Develop and maintain supporting backend services and microservices in Java, using Spring Boot and related frameworks, based on the CMS architecture.  

Deploy and operate CMS services using Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud platforms.  

Troubleshoot and resolve CMS, performance, scalability, integration, and production issues, including JVM\-level performance and memory tuning.  

Develop unit, integration, and API tests using JUnit and related Java testing frameworks, and contribute to CI/CD and engineering automation.  

Participate in technical design discussions, code reviews, and continuous improvement of the CMS platform.  

Leverage AI coding assistants and AI agents to improve development productivity, code quality, testing, documentation, and engineering workflows.  

Explore and build AI\-powered capabilities and agentic workflows for CMS use cases, where appropriate.  

Collaborate with product managers, architects, frontend engineers, DevOps teams, and content stakeholders.  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**  

Hands\-on experience with Java\-based CMS or content platforms and their extension APIs.  

Experience with DAM or PIM solutions and integrations supporting content\-as\-a\-service at scale.  

Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud platforms for deploying JVM services.  

Experience with caching and search technologies such as Redis, Memcached, Elasticsearch, or Solr.  

Experience with event\-driven architectures using Kafka or similar messaging systems.  

Experience with modern JavaScript frameworks (React / Vue / Angular) for CMS authoring interfaces.  

Hands\-on experience using AI/ML tools and AI coding assistants to accelerate development, testing, and operational excellence.  

  

**Minimum Qualifications**  

3\+ years of professional software development experience building scalable, highly available backend and web applications in Java.  

Hands\-on experience with Java (Java 11 or later) and the Spring / Spring Boot ecosystem, including dependency injection, Spring MVC, and Spring Data.  

A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent work experience, with a focus on fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, and object\-oriented design.  

Experience designing and developing RESTful and/or GraphQL web services in Java.  

Working knowledge of SQL and NoSQL databases and data modeling for content\-heavy applications.  

Experience with Java build and CI/CD tooling such as Maven or Gradle, Git, and Jenkins.  

Experience writing unit and integration tests with JUnit, Mockito, or similar frameworks.

title: Software Development Engineer II
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS)  

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.  

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.  

  

AIS is seeking a highly motivated and passionate Software Development Engineer who is responsible for designing, developing, testing, and deploying Supply Chain Software and Application. In this role you will collaborate with business leaders, work backwards from customers, identify problems, propose innovative solutions, relentlessly raise standards, and have a positive impact on AWS Infrastructure Supply Chain \& Procurement. In this, you will work closely with a team of Data Engineers and Data Scientists to architect the application programming interface (API) and user Interface (UI) in context with the business outcomes. You will be responsible for the full software development life cycle to build scalable application and deploy in AWS Cloud with high security bar.  

These are all greenfield projects offering a rare opportunity to build systems from the ground up. You will be part of a Supply Chain Automation team within AWS building large scale distributed applications, designing and developing systems from scratch utilizing technologies and frameworks like reactive micro services, serverless computing and distributed NoSQL data stores.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Solve complex architecture and business problems to come up with extensible solutions.
* Work with business leaders, Data Engineers, and Data Scientists to ideate business\-friendly software solutions.
* Design client\-side and server\-side architecture for Supply Chain applications.
* Write high quality code that is modular, functional and testable.
* Develop functional databases, applications, and servers to support Supply Chain platforms.
* Write effective APIs and develop technical specifications and documentation.
* Test software to ensure responsiveness and efficiency; troubleshoot, debug and upgrade applications.
* Formally mentor junior engineers on design, coding and troubleshooting.
* Communicate, collaborate and work effectively in a global environment.
**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
* 5\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience
* 3\+ years of non\-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 5\+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Experience building complex software systems that have been successfully delivered to customers
* Experience communicating with users, other technical teams, and management to collect requirements, describe software product features, and technical designs
* Experience with Supply Chain Planning and Procurement system development is a plus

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Senior Product Owner
description:
Overview:

The Senior Product Owner works to fulfill the strategic product roadmap established by the Product Management leadership team and meet business objectives. The person in this position manages multiple teams and backlogs for more than one product and/or for more complex products. This role is responsible for defining the detailed product deliverables. The Senior Product Owner must have a firm understanding of the business domain and product needs taking into account multiple types of users utilizing each solution. This position works closely with engineering on the specifications to ensure their Agile teams have all of the information needed to deliver a product that provides maximum value to the users.
Duties \& Responsibilities:
* Collaborate with Product Managers to understand the market demands, priorities, and overall product strategy.
* Partner with UX and Product Managers on market research efforts to understand and prioritize customer needs.
* Work with one or more engineering teams to deliver timely, quality releases that provide high business value and exceed customer expectations.
* Flexibility to support more than one product within a portfolio, potentially across value streams
* Translate product strategy into detailed requirements and prototypes
* Work with the Product Manager and Agile team to define the scope included in a release.
* Understand user personas and partner with UX to develop
* Create detailed specifications/requirements for the product features so they are clearly understood by the development team.

title: Staff Product Manager – Digital Assets
description:
Nium provides global infrastructure for real\-time cross\-border payments. We were founded on the mission to deliver the global payments infrastructure of tomorrow, today. Our platform enables banks, fintechs, and global businesses to move money instantly, everywhere.



Co\-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore with offices in 14 markets worldwide, we are entering one of the most exciting chapters in our journey. In March 2026, we delivered the largest month in our 11\-year history with record revenue, record volumes, and EBITDA profitability. Today, Nium moves nearly $60B in payments annually, almost entirely for enterprises, while continuing to strengthen an already healthy balance sheet.



It is an incredible time to join us, and we are only just getting started.



Our payout network spans 190\+ countries and 100 currencies, with 100 \+ corridors in real time. We power seamless transfers to accounts, wallets, and cards, support local collections in 35 markets, and as a principal card issuer on Visa, Mastercard, Discover, and UATP, Nium issues over 50 million card tokens every year. Backed by regulatory licenses in 40\+ markets, we make it simple for our partners to onboard, integrate, and scale globally. This scale and innovation have earned us recognition as one of CNBC’s World’s Top Fintech Companies 2025, winner of Best Cross\-Border Payments Solution at the PayTech Awards, and inclusion in FXC Intelligence’s Top 100 Cross\-Border Payments Companies list.



In 2024, we raised US$50 million in Series E funding at a US$1\.4 billion valuation to accelerate network expansion, product innovation, and talent growth. With the B2B payments market projected to hit US$175 trillion by 2030, Nium offers ambitious builders the chance to shape the future of global money movement with the scale of a leader and the energy of a high\-growth company.

 **About the Role**



Nium moves billions in payments every month for some of the world’s most demanding companies — banks, fintechs, and enterprise platforms operating across 100\+ countries. We built that on fiat rails. The next layer is digital currency: stablecoins, on/off\-ramps, and card products that let customers spend, settle, and move value in USDC as naturally as they do in dollars or euros.



We’re hiring a Staff PM – Digital Assets to own that build. Not the strategy document — the actual product. If you’ve shipped a stablecoin wallet, a crypto\-funded card, or a fiat\-to\-digital conversion flow and you understand what it takes to get that through compliance, engineering, and go\-live in a regulated environment, this is your rol



### **Responsibilities**


* Own stablecoin\-funded card products — physical and virtual cards funded from or settled in stablecoins (USDC and equivalents). Define the product, get it through compliance, ship it.
* Build digital asset support into Nium’s multi\-currency wallet — hold, convert, and send stablecoins alongside fiat currencies. This is a wallet extension, not a new product line.
* Design and ship on/off\-ramp flows — fiat\-to\-digital and digital\-to\-fiat conversion, including rate logic, settlement timing, and failure handling. Own the full customer experience.
* Drive stablecoin\-based cross\-border settlement — payin and payout flows that clear on digital rails. Work with network and settlement teams to make these production\-grade.
* Evaluate and integrate custodians, exchanges, and blockchain infrastructure — as infrastructure decisions with integration timelines and SLAs, not as partnership strategy.
* Own compliance product design for digital assets — MiCA, VASP frameworks, travel rule, FinCEN requirements. These get built into the product spec, not handed off to legal.
### **Requirements**

* 7\+ years in product management. Fintech, crypto infrastructure, or payments required.
* You’ve shipped at least one digital asset product in production — a stablecoin wallet, a crypto card, an on/off\-ramp, or a digital settlement rail. Not a prototype. Not a strategy deck.
* Strong payments foundation — cross\-border flows, FX, wallets, settlement mechanics. Digital assets are an extension of this, not a departure from it.
* Regulatory fluency as a product skill — you know what MiCA, travel rule, VASP registration, and FinCEN MSB requirements mean for your spec, your launch sequence, and your go/no\-go decisions.
* Experience working with custodians, blockchain infrastructure, or card networks — enough to evaluate integration tradeoffs and write requirements that engineering can build against.
* Comfortable operating in high\-ambiguity, high\-compliance environments — you know when to move and when to wait for legal sign\-off.
### **How We’ll Measure Success**


* Volume settled on digital rails (stablecoin payins \+ payouts) — tracked quarterly against target
* Card activation rate and spend volume for stablecoin\-funded card products
* On/off\-ramp conversion rate and time\-to\-settlement
* Time\-to\-integration for new custodian or blockchain network partners
* Regulatory coverage: number of markets with compliant, live digital asset product
**What we offer at Nium**

**We Value Performance:** Through competitive salaries, performance bonuses, sales commissions, equity for specific roles and recognition programs, we ensure that all our employees are well rewarded and incentivized for their hard work.

**We Care for Our Employees:** The wellness of Nium’ers is our \#1 priority. We offer medical coverage along with 24/7 employee assistance program, generous vacation programs including our year\-end shut down. We also provide a flexible working hybrid working environment (3 days per week in the office).

**We Upskill Ourselves:** We are curious, and always want to learn more with a focus on upskilling ourselves. We provide role\-specific training, internal workshops, and a learning stipend.

**We Celebrate Together:** We recognize that work is also about creating great relationships with each other. We celebrate together with company\-wide social events, team bonding activities, happy hours, team offsites, and much more!

**We Thrive with Diversity:** Nium is truly a global company, with more than 33 nationalities, based in 18\+ countries and more than 10 office locations. As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to providing a safe and welcoming environment for everyone.  


**Beware of recruitment scams:** Be cautious of individuals impersonating Nium via WhatsApp, social media, email or unofficial websites. **Do not respond, share personal or financial information, or make any payments**. Nium will never ask candidates to transfer money or cryptocurrency as part of our recruitment process.
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Senior Product Manager, Amazon - Sub Same Day
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Across Emerging Markets (10 countries across APAC, MENA and LATAM), Amazon has an opportunity to engage the next 500MM customers and build a $100B GMS profitable business in the next 3 years. The Sub Same Day team will build for this market to deliver shopping orders to our customers within the same day in a reliable manner. The program is rapidly growing, is highly cross\-functional in nature, intensive and requires a number of solutions to be built and scaled. We build extensible EM first solutions to drive SSD program’s product strategy and Improve Fulfillment Convenience for customers while reducing overall Cost to Serve.  

  

This role is responsible for driving a roadmap specifically for daily essentials, grocery, perishables served from Sub Same Day network at Amazon across IES. If you like to swim in unchartered territories then this is your opportunity to solve problems that no one has attempted to solve at our scale before. We work like an high\-octane startup driven by the passion to bring the Amazon experience to our customers across Emerging Marketplaces.
  

  

As a Senior Product Manager, you will be expected to come up with the PR/FAQ, vision, and business requirements for the some of the most impactful ideas contributing to customer experience WW. This will need you to understand pain points of various types of customers, prioritize business needs that could be different across countries, while coming up with well thought out product ideas that leverage some of the latest advancements in technology. You will launch products, and take them to market, demonstrating business impact across countries.  

  

The ideal candidate will be enthusiastic about managing challenging, lengthy projects across multiple teams and locations and will run their initiatives like a business owner. They will be comfortable marshaling large amounts of data, and expert with new\-age technology domains to make recommendations and build business cases. We are looking for a tenured Product leader who shares Amazon's passion for the customer—someone who understands the importance of compelling features and functionalities in driving great experience. In addition, the candidate will also be able to influence without authority and earn trust of a wide range of cross\-functional, tech/non\-tech stakeholders.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Identify and prioritize the most impactful improvement opportunities across New and Existing customers specific to their Sub Same Day delivery experiences across all emerging markets
* Be the voice of the customer advocating for the ideal customer experience
* Build products creating meaningful long term positive impact to the business
* Align key/Senior stakeholders to a bold vision for SSD through PRFAQs and other strategy documents
* strive to build products improving the delivery experience and speed for our customers
* Benchmark competitive experiences across Emerging Countries (outside of North Americas, Japan, UK), and define and implement a roadmap of improvements in customer Experience.
**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5\+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience with end to end product delivery
* Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
* Master's degree or equivalent

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* MBA
* Experience in influencing senior leadership through data driven insights
* Experience working across functional teams and senior stakeholders

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Teamhead Business Insights
description:
SPEED \& SPIRIT is what we look for in our candidates, defined by some simple values that inspire us to BE DRIVEN in our performance, BE VIBRANT in our sporting legacy, BE TOGETHER in our team spirit, and BE YOU to let our individual talent and experience shine. Applying for a job at PUMA is easy. Simply click APPLY ONLINE and follow the steps to upload your application.


  
**Your mission**
----------------


The analytical engine that powers commercial decision\-making across Global eCommerce.


* Lead the Business Insights function and serve as the central insight engine for Global eCommerce, transforming data into actionable business recommendations across key commercial levers.
* Synthesize insights across merchandising, pricing, promotions, demand, marketing, CRM, content, customer behavior,supply chainand purchase performance to create a holistic view of business opportunities, risks, and performance gaps.
* Lead and develop a team of Business Insights Managers responsible for deep\-dive analytics, root\-cause analysis, opportunity sizing, and recommendation development.
* Establish scalable analytical frameworks, decision\-driver trees, playbooks, and workflows that enable consistent problem\-solving and performance improvement across markets.
* Drive data\-driven decision\-making by ensuring insights are commercially relevant, actionable, and aligned to strategic priorities, with success measured through insight quality, recommendation adoption, and business value creation.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


* Establish a performance diagnosis \& review rhythm focused on material changes, drivers, decisions and actions.
* Lead root\-cause investigations across core eCommerce\& customer KPIs by driver tree decomposition across customer funnel metrics
* Use driver trees, segmentation, scenario modeling and opportunity sizing to drive impactful decisions across key levers –buying, pricing, demand shaping, content, performance marketing \& CRM
* Apply driver trees, segmentation, cohort, funnel and variance analysis to explain performance changes.
* Form and test hypotheses, distinguish signal from noise and quantify the size of opportunities.
* Combine multiple data sources and business context into a coherent commercial view
* Synthesize insights generated across merchandising, pricing, promotions, demand, marketing, CRM, content, and customer analytics to develop cohesive, cross\-functional recommendations that maximize commercial impact and business performance.
* Connect functional deep dives into a unified business narrative, prioritizing the highest\-value opportunities and translating them into scalable action plans, playbooks, and market interventions.
* Steward reporting standards, analytical methodologies, data consumption frameworks and capability effectiveness. Ensure solutions remain commercially relevant, scalable, trusted and globally consistent. Build scalable playbooks which can be leveraged and replicated
* Lead, coach and develop Data Analysts and Data Storytelling specialists. Establish high standards for requirement definition, analytical rigor, business translation and executive communication.
* Act as the primary analytics capability partner across Product, Technology, Data Engineering, BI, AI/ML and global COE teams. Drive clarity on priorities, scope, dependencies and expected outcomes.

---------------

* Experience working with complex datasets and translating findings into business recommendations..
* Experience in eCom platforms \-consumer or digital\-first brand businesses preferred; global matrix experience is advantageous.
**Our principles**
------------------


PUMA provides equal opportunities for all job applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or disability. Equality for all is one of the core principles at PUMA and we do not tolerate any form of harassment or discrimination.

title: DevSecOps Engineer
description:
**About Tarento:**  

Tarento is a fast\-growing technology consulting company headquartered in Stockholm, with a strong presence in India and clients across the globe. We specialize in digital transformation, product engineering, and enterprise solutions, working across diverse industries including retail, manufacturing, and healthcare. Our teams combine Nordic values with Indian expertise to deliver innovative, scalable, and high\-impact solutions.  

We're proud to be recognized as a **Great Place to Work**, a testament to our inclusive culture, strong leadership, and commitment to employee well\-being and growth. At Tarento, you’ll be part of a collaborative environment where ideas are valued, learning is continuous, and careers are built on passion and purpose. **Role Overview**  

We are hiring an experienced DevSecOps Engineer with strong expertise in AWS Cloud, container orchestration (Kubernetes / ECS etc.), and secure CI/CD deployments.
The ideal candidate will manage and optimize application deployments, troubleshoot production issues, and apply DevOps and security best practices to ensure high availability, scalability, reliability, and compliance of our cloud workloads. **Key Responsibilities**  

* This role is hands\-on and operational — focused on running, securing, and stabilizing production systems.
* Manage and optimize application deployments across AWS EKS, ECS, and EC2 environments.
* Oversee production operations, incident management, and root cause analysis (RCA) for critical issues.
* Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, or AWS CodePipeline.
* Ensure secure deployment processes through integrated scanning tools (Snyk, Trivy, SonarQube, rapid7\) and vulnerability management.
* Implement \& Monitor system health using CloudWatch, Prometheus, Grafana, and ELK, ensuring proactive alerts and observability.
* Administer and manage AWS services including S3, EC2, ECR, ECS, EKS, Lambda (serverless), SNS, SES, and Secrets Manager.
* Configure and secure networking components — VPC, subnets, route tables, NAT gateways, security groups, load balancers (ALB/NLB), CloudFront, API Gateway, and WAF.
* Enforce AWS IAM and network security best practices, including least\-privilege policies and secure key management.
* Collaborate with development and QA teams to optimize application performance, reliability, and security posture.
* Drive and promote a “Security by Design” mindset and SRE\-driven reliability culture within the DevOps ecosystem.

 **Required Skills \& Experience:**  

* Proven hands\-on experience managing AWS production environments — EKS, ECS, EC2, S3, CloudFront, API Gateway, WAF, SNS, SES, Secrets Manager, CloudWatch, VPC, IAM.
* Strong understanding of containerization (Docker) and container orchestration (Kubernetes / ECS).
* Proficiency with CI/CD tools — Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, AWS CodePipeline.
* Strong networking knowledge — VPC design, subnets, DNS, routing, SSL/TLS, load balancing, and firewall rules.
* Experience implementing DevSecOps practices — scanning, policy enforcement, and compliance monitoring.
* Skilled in troubleshooting across infrastructure, networking, and application layers.
* Experience with monitoring and alerting stacks — Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, CloudWatch.
* Scripting experience using Bash, Python, YAML, and JSON.

**Good to Have Skills:**  

* Certifications such as AWS Certified DevOps Engineer, CKA / CKAD, or AWS SysOps Administrator.
* Familiarity with service mesh (Istio / App Mesh) and policy\-as\-code tools (OPA, Kyverno).
* Experience with runtime security platforms (Falco, Aqua, Prisma Cloud).
* Terraforms, CloudFormation for deployment automation.
* Knowledge of Zero Trust architecture and AWS Security Hub / GuardDuty.
* Exposure to incident response automation or resilience engineering practices.

**Education:****BE/BTech**, Information Technology, or related discipline.

title: Delightree - Senior Design Engineer
description:
### **About the role**


This role splits roughly in half.


The first half is designing for franchise operations \- multi location brands, franchisee owners, and frontline staff each needing something different from the same product.


The second half is owning the layer between design and code. You'll own the design system \- the components, patterns, and code. You'll write frontend code yourself, and you'll define how design work becomes a shipped interface for everyone else on the team.


That second half is why this role exists. Our approach to product development is shifting. Instead of traditional mockup handoffs, product managers and designers directly build working prototypes directly in code, using AI workflows alongside our component library. Engineering builds on those prototypes rather than starting over. You own this system and ensure it's up to scale and quality.

### **What you'll do**

* Design and build UI in the same motion \- prototyping novel AI\-native interactions directly in code rather than in Figma\-then\-handoff, especially where no pattern library exists yet.
* Sit inside a pod (PM \+ eng lead \+ you) and take features from concept to shipped, rather than handing off a spec and waiting.
* Own the interaction and motion details \- loading/streaming states, transitions, micro\-interactions \- the polish that's nearly impossible to fully spec in a doc.
* Build and maintain shared UI components so the rest of the org can move fast without reinventing patterns feature by feature.
* Work directly in the production codebase.

### **What we're looking for**

* 4\+ years in product design, with depth in dense interfaces \- tables, forms, permissions, multi role flows.
* Real product/visual design judgment *and* the ability to ship real frontend code \- not a designer who dabbles in code or an engineer who cares about UI, but someone for whom design and implementation are the same skill.
* Hands\-on frontend engineering. A portfolio \+ GitHub showing shipped, interactive, polished products \- not just mockups or case studies.
* Design systems built and maintained at scale, in code. You should be able to direct AI tools to build and maintain prototypes that adhere to accessibility, component system, and other guardrails.
* Experience or strong interest in AI\-native interfaces: streaming output, agentic/human\-in\-the\-loop UX, confidence and uncertainty in UI.
* Bonus: has worked somewhere small enough that design and engineering weren't separate functions. AI used structurally in how features got shipped, from ideation through implementation and review \- not just for copy or asset generation.

* Collaborate with development and QA teams to optimize application performance, reliability, and security posture.

 **Required Skills \& Experience:**  

* Proven hands\-on experience managing AWS production environments — EKS, ECS, EC2, S3, CloudFront, API Gateway, WAF, SNS, SES, Secrets Manager, CloudWatch, VPC, IAM.
* Strong understanding of containerization (Docker) and container orchestration (Kubernetes / ECS).

* Strong networking knowledge — VPC design, subnets, DNS, routing, SSL/TLS, load balancing, and firewall rules.
* Experience implementing DevSecOps practices — scanning, policy enforcement, and compliance monitoring.
* Skilled in troubleshooting across infrastructure, networking, and application layers.
* Experience with monitoring and alerting stacks — Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, CloudWatch.
* Scripting experience using Bash, Python, YAML, and JSON.

**Good to Have Skills:**  

* Certifications such as AWS Certified DevOps Engineer, CKA / CKAD, or AWS SysOps Administrator.
* Familiarity with service mesh (Istio / App Mesh) and policy\-as\-code tools (OPA, Kyverno).
* Experience with runtime security platforms (Falco, Aqua, Prisma Cloud).
* Terraforms, CloudFormation for deployment automation.
* Knowledge of Zero Trust architecture and AWS Security Hub / GuardDuty.
* Exposure to incident response automation or resilience engineering practices.

**Education:****BE/BTech**, Information Technology, or related discipline.

title: Senior Staff Product Manager - AI Agents (Migration & Onboarding)
description:
**Overview**
------------


Come join the QuickBooks Desktop team (part of Mid\-Market Segment) as a Senior Staff Product Manager, AI Migration \& Onboarding Agent.


QuickBooks is Intuit's flagship accounting software, powering millions of small and mid\-sized businesses globally. The Mid\-Market team is driving a critical transformation: migrating customers from Desktop to cloud\-native platforms.


Today, migration from desktop to cloud is high\-friction and high\-touch. It slows conversion and strains support capacity. Your mission is to change that by building an AI Agent that guides customers through the entire migration journey, from readiness assessment to data migration, configuration, and first productive use.


This is a zero\-to\-one role. You will own the vision, strategy, and execution for this agent, working at the intersection of LLMs, agentic architectures, and accounting domain knowledge to turn migration from a barrier into a growth engine.

 **Responsibilities**

* Own the AI Migration Agent end\-to\-end: Define vision, strategy, and roadmap for an AI agent that guides customers through complex product migrations, from readiness assessment through post\-migration validation.
* Design for scalability and reuse: Architect the agent as a modular platform capability that can be extended to multiple source systems, customer segments, and net\-new onboarding journeys.
* Define AI/Human collaboration: Design patterns where the agent handles routine tasks autonomously and escalates complex decisions to domain experts, support teams, or customers.
* Build the knowledge backbone: Own the agent's knowledge base, including product mapping logic, feature parity data, gap analysis rules, and domain\-specific reasoning.
* Drive adoption and migration velocity: Define success metrics (completion rate, time\-to\-value, CSAT, support deflection) and build feedback loops to continuously improve agent performance.
* Lead cross\-functional execution: Align engineering, AI/ML, design, data science, sales, care, and operations around an agent\-first migration strategy. Partner with platform teams to leverage shared AI infrastructure.
* Close the customer insight loop: Research migrating customers, domain experts, and internal teams to uncover friction points and benchmark against AI\-driven migration experiences in SaaS and Fintech.

 **Qualifications**

* Experience: 10\+ years in product management with 2\+ years shipping AI agent, conversational AI, or intelligent automation products in B2B SaaS or Fintech.
* AI Agent expertise: Deep understanding of agentic architectures, LLMs, RAG systems, orchestration frameworks, and evaluation pipelines. Experience defining guardrails, confidence thresholds, and human\-in\-the\-loop escalation patterns.
* B2B SaaS Migration experience: Track record building customer migration, data portability, or onboarding products. Understands the complexity of moving business\-critical data between systems at scale.
* Platform thinking: Designs modular, reusable agent capabilities that serve multiple source systems, customer segments, and journey types.
* Customer empathy: Deep experience with SMB/mid\-market customers. Understands the friction and anxiety customers face when switching business\-critical software.
* Analytical rigor: Comfortable defining and tracking agent performance metrics like accuracy, task completion, escalation rate, and time\-to\-value.
* Cross\-functional influence: Proven ability to align engineering, AI/ML, design, and GTM teams around a shared product vision in a matrixed organization.
* Education: Undergraduate degree required (technical discipline preferred). MBA or advanced degree is preferred.


Preferred

* Hands\-on experience with LLM\-based agent frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, or equivalent).
* Familiarity with prompt engineering, fine\-tuning, and AI evaluation techniques.
* Experience in accounting, ERP, or financial software domains.
* Top\-Tier or International MBA or other Advanced degree preferred.

  

Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers \| Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job\-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location.
